title.zh: Cysic攻击者向Tornado Cash转移约74.4万美元，不理会10%白帽赏金
title.en: Cysic exploiter moves ~$744K to Tornado Cash, shrugging off 10% white-hat bounty

summary.zh: 与Cysic跨链桥漏洞利用相关的地址向混币器Tornado Cash（龙卷风现金）存入了300枚ETH和30.4枚BNB，合计约74.4万美元，链上安全公司PeckShield对此进行了标记。该攻击者此前在BNB智能链（BNB Smart Chain）上未经授权铸造了1000万枚CYS代币，而Cysic基金会日前向其开出10%赏金，换取返还约90%的ETH收益。攻击者以太坊钱包中目前仅剩约45美元的ETH，资金追回前景黯淡。
summary.en: Addresses tied to the Cysic bridge exploit deposited 300 ETH and 30.4 BNB, worth about $744,000, into the mixer Tornado Cash, blockchain security firm PeckShield flagged. The attacker had previously minted 10 million CYS tokens on BNB Smart Chain without authorization, and the Cysic Foundation had offered a 10% bounty in exchange for the return of roughly 90% of the identified ETH proceeds. The attacker's Ethereum wallet now holds only about $45 in ETH, dimming recovery prospects.

title.zh: 美国SEC将证券代币化列入2027财年检查重点，加密资产连续第二年缺席
title.en: US SEC adds tokenization to FY2027 exam priorities; crypto absent for second straight year

summary.zh: 美国证券交易委员会（SEC）检查部门发布2027财年检查重点，将证券代币化（tokenization）列为关键市场基础设施与清算机构检查的高风险领域，并与超智能（SI）、延长交易时段和量子计算（quantum computing）并列。报告20页全文未提及crypto或数字资产，这也是加密资产连续第二年未被单列为检查类别。检查重点只是合规审查指南，不构成新规，但表明传统金融向代币化基础设施演进已进入监管视野。
summary.en: The SEC's Division of Examinations released its fiscal 2027 examination priorities, naming tokenization of securities a high-risk area for examinations of critical market infrastructure and clearing agencies, alongside super intelligence (SI), extended trading hours and quantum computing. The 20-page report makes no mention of crypto or digital assets, marking the second consecutive year crypto is absent as a standalone examination category. The priorities guide compliance reviews rather than creating new rules, but signal that TradFi's move toward tokenized infrastructure is now on the regulator's radar.

title.zh: 比特币回落至8.15万美元附近考验8万美元关口，十月恐录得7月以来首月下跌
title.en: Bitcoin retreats toward $81,500 as $80K support is tested; October heads for first monthly loss since July

summary.zh: 比特币周五跌回约8.15万美元，24小时跌幅约3%，最低触及约8.08万美元，距离关键的8万美元心理关口仅一步之遥。抛售并非加密市场原生因素：中东紧张局势推高油价（布伦特原油突破116美元创半年新高），加上科技股暴跌（纳斯达克指数周四下挫2.6%）拖累整体风险资产，投机资金率先从高贝塔资产撤出。若8万美元失守，本月恐录得7月以来的首次月度下跌。
summary.en: Bitcoin slid back to around $81,500 on Friday, down about 3% in 24 hours with a session low near $80,800, leaving it within reach of the key $80,000 psychological level. The selloff was not crypto-native: escalating Middle East tensions pushed Brent crude above $116 for a six-month high, while a tech-stock rout (the Nasdaq Composite fell 2.6% on Thursday) dragged risk assets lower, with speculative capital retreating from high-beta assets first. A decisive close below $80,000 would confirm October's first monthly loss since July.

title.zh: 美国现货比特币ETF周四净流出6.36亿美元，创6月以来最大单日流出
title.en: US spot Bitcoin ETFs post $636M Thursday outflows, largest single-day withdrawal since June

summary.zh: 美国现货比特币ETF（Spot Bitcoin ETF）周四录得约6.356亿美元净流出，为6月以来最大单日流出，扭转了此前三日的净流入势头。贝莱德（BlackRock）IBIT流出2.541亿美元领衔，富达（Fidelity）FBTC流出2.175亿美元，ARKB流出1.094亿美元；摩根士丹利（Morgan Stanley）的MSBT逆势小幅流入230万美元。尽管单日大幅回吐，本周ETF资金流仍为净流入约4.43亿美元，终结了此前连续两周的净流出。
summary.en: US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded about $635.6 million in net outflows on Thursday, the largest single-day withdrawal since June, reversing a three-day inflow streak. BlackRock's IBIT led with $254.1 million in outflows, followed by Fidelity's FBTC at $217.5 million and ARKB at $109.4 million; Morgan Stanley's MSBT bucked the trend with a $2.3 million inflow. Despite the one-day giveback, weekly ETF flows remain positive at about $442.7 million, ending two consecutive weeks of net outflows.

title.zh: 现货以太币ETF周四净流出1.106亿美元，重返流出通道
title.en: Spot Ether ETFs return to outflows with $110.6M Thursday redemptions

summary.zh: 美国现货以太币ETF（Spot Ether ETF）周四净流出1.106亿美元，其中贝莱德（BlackRock）ETHA流出7545万美元，在仅短暂回补一天后重返净流出。Solana和Hyperliquid相关ETF当日同样净流出，仅XRP基金逆势小幅流入360万美元。十月以来以太币ETF累计净流出已达约10.8亿美元，为年内最大单月流出，机构需求疲弱仍是ETH价格承压的重要因素。
summary.en: US spot Ether ETFs recorded $110.6 million in net outflows on Thursday, with BlackRock's ETHA accounting for $75.45 million, returning to redemptions after just one day of inflows. Solana and Hyperliquid ETFs also saw net outflows that day, while XRP funds were the lone outlier with a $3.6 million inflow. October net outflows from Ether ETFs have reached about $1.08 billion, the largest monthly withdrawal of the year, as weak institutional demand keeps weighing on ETH.

title.zh: 以太坊Glamsterdam升级延期：Hoodi测试网10月26日激活取消，研究EIP-8037安全风险
title.en: Ethereum delays Glamsterdam: Oct 26 Hoodi testnet activation canceled over EIP-8037 security review

summary.zh: 以太坊核心开发者在第248次执行层共识电话会议（ACDE #248）上决定推迟Glamsterdam升级在Hoodi测试网的激活，原定于10月26日17:42:48 UTC的激活已被取消，暂无新的时间表。推迟的原因是安全公司ChainSecurity标记了13个已部署合约，其行为可能因EIP-8037的gas计量方式变更而改变，开发者需要更多时间研究其与现有主网合约的交互。随升级一同推迟的还有Hoodi的区块gas上限提升至2亿的计划。
summary.en: Ethereum core developers decided on the ACDE #248 call to delay the Glamsterdam upgrade's activation on the Hoodi testnet, canceling the October 26 activation scheduled for 17:42:48 UTC, with no replacement date set. The delay stems from security firm ChainSecurity flagging 13 deployed contracts whose behavior could change under EIP-8037's gas-accounting changes, and developers want more time to study interactions with existing mainnet contracts. The planned Hoodi gas-limit increase to 200 million is postponed along with the upgrade.

title.zh: Glassnode：比特币国库公司月度增持不足2024年峰值的10%，平均持仓成本约8.02万美元
title.en: Glassnode: Bitcoin treasury companies' monthly buying under 10% of 2024 peak; avg cost ~$80,200

summary.zh: Glassnode 10月21日发布的链上周报显示，其追踪的比特币国库公司平均持仓成本约为8.02万美元，比特币自9月18日以来每日收盘价均高于该水平。尽管整体处于盈利状态，公司增持并未随价格回升而恢复：自6月以来每月新增持仓均不足2024年11月峰值的10%。Strategy上周（10月12-18日）仅增持267枚BTC，均价约8.29万美元，当前共持有848,517枚，均价约7.54万美元。
summary.en: Glassnode's October 21 Week Onchain report estimates the average acquisition cost of its tracked Bitcoin treasury-company cohort at about $80,200, with Bitcoin's daily close above that level every day since September 18. Despite being in profit overall, corporate buying has not recovered with the price rebound: every monthly addition since June has stayed below 10% of the November 2024 peak. Strategy added just 267 BTC during October 12-18 at an average of about $82,900, holding 848,517 BTC at an average purchase price of about $75,446.

title.zh: Bitmine再质押15.97万枚ETH（约3.9亿美元），质押份额达国库86.5%
title.en: Bitmine stakes another 159,728 ETH (~$390M), pushing staked share to 86.5% of treasury

summary.zh: 由Tom Lee担任董事长的Bitmine于10月21日再质押159,728枚ETH（约3.906亿美元），累计质押量达到约523万枚ETH，价值约127.8亿美元，占其约604万枚ETH国库的86.5%。其持仓已占ETH流通供应量的约4.9%，距离Lee设定的5%供应量硬顶仅差约6.35万枚。Bitmine未使用看跌或对冲头寸，大规模质押既赚取网络收益，也从可交易流通盘中锁定了大量ETH。
summary.en: Tom Lee-chaired Bitmine staked another 159,728 ETH (about $390.6 million) on October 21, taking total staked holdings to roughly 5.23 million ETH, worth about $12.78 billion, or 86.5% of its approximately 6.04 million ETH treasury. Its holdings now represent about 4.9% of ETH's circulating supply, leaving it roughly 63,500 ETH short of Lee's self-imposed 5% supply hard cap. The large-scale staking earns network yield while locking a significant share of ETH out of the tradable float.

title.zh: 印度交易所CoinDCX被指出现约1600万美元可疑转账，官方否认遭新攻击
title.en: CoinDCX faces $16M suspicious-transfer claims; exchange denies new breach

summary.zh: 区块链调查员Darcy于10月22日标记了与印度交易所CoinDCX相关地址约1600万美元（约1599万USDT与5783枚TRX）的可疑转账，资金流向TRON网络单一地址后被分散至多个钱包。多名链上侦探对交易所的说法提出质疑，而CoinDCX联合创始人Sumit Gupta否认发生新的安全事件，称相关地址在2025年7月事件中已被攻破、不属于交易所当前运营。目前转账本身尚未被证实为新的黑客攻击。
summary.en: Blockchain investigator Darcy flagged about $16 million in suspicious transfers (roughly 15.99M USDT and 5,783 TRX) from addresses associated with Indian exchange CoinDCX on Oct 22, with funds moving to a single TRON address before being split across wallets. Several on-chain sleuths questioned the exchange's account, while co-founder Sumit Gupta denied a new security breach, saying the flagged addresses were compromised in the July 2025 incident and are not part of current operations. The transfers alone have not been confirmed as a new hack.

title.zh: 以太坊ETF结束连续流出转为净流入，但十月累计仍大幅失血
title.en: Ether ETFs end outflow streak with modest inflows; October remains deep in the red

summary.zh: 美国现货以太坊ETF在10月21日录得约1500万美元净流入，结束了10月14-20日连续五个交易日、合计约3.89亿美元的资金流出。其中灰度以太坊迷你信托（Ethereum Mini Trust）与富达FETH领涨，而贝莱德ETHA仍录得约2930万美元赎回。尽管单日转正，十月累计仍为净流出，机构需求尚未实质恢复。
summary.en: US spot Ethereum ETFs recorded about $15 million of net inflows on Oct 21, ending a five-session outflow streak that drained roughly $389 million from Oct 14 to 20. Grayscale's Ethereum Mini Trust and Fidelity's FETH led the inflows, while BlackRock's ETHA saw another $29.3 million in redemptions. Despite the single-day rebound, October remains a net-outflow month for the category.

title.zh: 美国现货比特币ETF三日净流入10.8亿美元，十月资金流转正
title.en: US spot Bitcoin ETFs pull $1.08B over three days as October flows turn positive

summary.zh: 美国现货比特币ETF在10月19-21日连续三个交易日合计净流入约10.8亿美元，其中10月21日单日净流入5.28亿美元，贝莱德IBIT（2.35亿美元）与富达FBTC（约2.13亿美元）贡献了大部分。十月累计净流入回到约4.61亿美元，扭转此前两周连续赎回的局面。同日以太坊ETF结束连续流出，Solana ETF也终结了13连流出。
summary.en: US spot Bitcoin ETFs drew roughly $1.08 billion over three consecutive sessions from Oct 19 to 21, with $528 million on Oct 21 alone, led by BlackRock's IBIT ($235M) and Fidelity's FBTC (~$213M). October's cumulative flows turned positive at about $461 million after two weeks of withdrawals. Ether ETFs also ended their outflow streak on the same day, while Solana ETFs snapped a 13-day streak of outflows.

title.zh: 比特币冲高8.5万美元后回落至8.2万美元附近，跟踪AI股抛售
title.en: Bitcoin reverses after approaching $85,000, tracking AI-stock selloff

summary.zh: 比特币在10月22日亚洲时段自前一交易日8.48万美元高点回落约2.2%，交投于8.2万-8.3万美元区间，回吐前一日涨幅。市场将此轮回落归因于AI概念股抛售引发的避险情绪，纳斯达克期货走弱拖累风险资产，加密相关股票跌幅更大。尽管价格承压，现货比特币ETF的机构资金流入仍在延续。
summary.en: Bitcoin fell about 2.2% in Asian trading on Oct 22, retreating to the $82,000-$83,000 range after reaching as high as $84,835 in the previous session. The pullback tracked weakness in Nasdaq futures as renewed AI-trade concerns dampened risk appetite, with crypto-related equities falling harder. Institutional demand via spot Bitcoin ETFs continued despite the price pressure.

title.zh: Solana完成Alpenglow主网升级，交易最终确认缩短至约0.15秒
title.en: Solana completes Alpenglow mainnet upgrade, cutting finality to ~0.15 seconds

summary.zh: Solana于10月21日完成Alpenglow共识升级的主网部署，将交易最终确认时间从约12.8秒缩短至约0.15秒（150毫秒）。升级以Votor协议取代原有的TowerBFT投票机制，验证者通过链下直接通信与BLS签名聚合（BLS signature aggregation）达成共识，不再将每笔投票写入链上。此次升级被视为Solana自2020年上线以来最大规模的共识机制改造。
summary.en: Solana completed the Alpenglow consensus upgrade on mainnet on Oct 21, reducing transaction finality from about 12.8 seconds to roughly 0.15 seconds. The upgrade replaces the TowerBFT voting mechanism with the Votor protocol, letting validators reach consensus through direct off-chain communication and BLS signature aggregation instead of recording every vote on-chain. It is described as Solana's largest consensus overhaul since its 2020 launch.

title.zh: 加州金融监管局致信SEC，反对加密豁免规则架空各州证券法
title.en: California DFPI urges SEC to drop crypto exemptions it says would preempt state securities laws

summary.zh: 加州金融保护与创新局（DFPI）向SEC提交意见信，反对其拟议的《加密资产监管条例》（Regulation Crypto Assets）中对部分数字资产发行的注册豁免，认为该豁免将架空各州证券注册要求，削弱各州对欺诈性发行的执法能力。DFPI警告，豁免可能使投资者失去针对欺诈或滥用发行的保护。该提案于8月发布，目前正处于意见征询后的审议阶段。
summary.en: California's Department of Financial Protection and Innovation filed a comment letter opposing the SEC's proposed Regulation Crypto Assets, arguing its exemptions for certain digital-asset offerings would preempt state registration requirements and weaken enforcement against fraudulent issuance. The DFPI warned investors could lose protections against fraud or abusive offerings. The proposal, unveiled in August, is now under review following the comment period.

title.zh: 美国OCC敲定GENIUS法案稳定币发行人规则，2027年1月18日生效
title.en: US OCC finalizes GENIUS Act stablecoin issuer rules, effective Jan 18, 2027

summary.zh: 美国货币监理署（OCC）10月21日敲定GENIUS法案下的支付型稳定币（payment stablecoin）最终规则，涵盖储备资产、客户赎回、托管与风险管理，规则与法案将于2027年1月18日同步生效。规则要求发行人维持至少100%的储备，并在两个工作日内处理客户赎回请求。最终规则保留了发行人不得直接向持币人支付利息的禁令，但删除了将第三方平台奖励安排一律推定为违规的条款，改为逐案审查。
summary.en: The US Office of the Comptroller of the Currency finalized rules for payment stablecoin issuers under the GENIUS Act on Oct 21, covering reserves, customer redemptions, custody and risk management; the rules take effect Jan 18, 2027. Issuers must hold reserves at least equal to outstanding coins and generally process redemptions within two business days. The final rule keeps the ban on issuers paying yield directly to holders but drops the presumption that third-party platform rewards arrangements violate it, opting for case-by-case review.

title.zh: Drift Protocol黑客两日内向Tornado Cash转移价值1.09亿美元的ETH
title.en: Drift Protocol exploiter moves $109M in ETH to Tornado Cash over two days

summary.zh: 与4月1日Drift Protocol约2.95亿美元黑客攻击相关的钱包，在10月20-21日两天内向混币器Tornado Cash转移了44,510枚ETH（约1.09亿美元），约占被盗资金的37%。链上追踪机构Lookonchain与Arkham的数据显示，攻击者地址在沉寂约两个月后重新活跃，剩余约5.66万枚ETH（约1.38亿美元）尚未转移。安全公司Mandiant此前已将该攻击归因于朝鲜黑客组织。
summary.en: Wallets tied to the April 1 Drift Protocol hack, which drained about $295 million, sent 44,510 ETH (about $109 million) into Tornado Cash on Oct 20-21, roughly 37% of the stolen funds. Data from trackers Lookonchain and Arkham shows the attacker addresses reactivated after about two months of dormancy, with roughly 56,569 ETH (about $138 million) still held. Security firm Mandiant previously attributed the attack to a North Korean hacking group.

title.zh: 以太坊Glamsterdam升级定于10月26日在Hoodi测试网激活
title.en: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade set for Oct 26 activation on Hoodi testnet

summary.zh: 以太坊基金会确认，Glamsterdam升级将于10月26日17:42:48 UTC在Hoodi测试网激活（epoch 132352），届时测试网区块Gas上限将提升至2亿。这是继10月6日Sepolia测试网激活后的第二次公开彩排，主网激活时间尚未确定。升级核心包括写入协议的提议者-构建者分离（ePBS）与区块级访问列表（block-level access lists），旨在提升并行交易处理能力。
summary.en: The Ethereum Foundation confirmed the Glamsterdam upgrade will activate on the Hoodi testnet on Oct 26 at 17:42:48 UTC (epoch 132,352), raising the testnet's block gas limit to 200 million. It is the second public rehearsal after the Oct 6 Sepolia activation; a mainnet date has not been set. The upgrade's core features are enshrined proposer-builder separation (ePBS) and block-level access lists, designed to improve parallel transaction processing.

title.zh: 英国FCA就DeFi指引与加密资产监管边界启动两份咨询，2027年新规倒计时
title.en: UK FCA opens two consultations on DeFi guidance and crypto regulatory perimeter ahead of 2027 regime

summary.zh: 英国金融行为监管局（FCA）10月21日发布两份咨询文件：GC26/7 针对使用去中心化金融（DeFi）的受监管企业，就运营韧性（operational resilience）、金融犯罪与反洗钱义务提供合规指引；CP26/36 则厘清新加密资产监管制度下的授权边界与豁免情形。两份咨询均将于11月18日截止，明年1月发布最终指引，而英国全面加密资产制度定于2027年10月25日生效。
summary.en: The UK's Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) on October 21 opened two consultations: GC26/7 sets out how regulated firms using decentralized finance (DeFi) should handle operational resilience, financial crime and money-laundering obligations, while CP26/36 clarifies the authorization perimeter and exclusions under the incoming cryptoasset regime. Both close on November 18, 2026, with final guidance planned for January 2027 ahead of the UK cryptoasset regime taking effect on October 25, 2027.

title.zh: MoonPay与Upbit母公司Dunamu达成战略合作，探索稳定币全球支付与GIWA生态扩张
title.en: MoonPay and Upbit parent Dunamu announce strategic collaboration on stablecoin payments and GIWA expansion

summary.zh: 加密支付公司MoonPay 10月20日宣布与韩国最大加密交易所Upbit的母公司Dunamu达成战略合作，计划共同探索基于稳定币（stablecoin）的全球支付与资金转移、企业财务与资金管理，以及扩大Dunamu以太坊二层网络GIWA的全球连接。目前尚无商业条款或上线时间表，双方仍在评估技术与商业可行性。这是韩国在《数字资产基本法》（Digital Asset Basic Act）立法推进期间又一起稳定币基础设施布局。
summary.en: Crypto payments firm MoonPay announced on October 20 a strategic collaboration with Dunamu, the parent of South Korea's largest exchange Upbit, to explore stablecoin-based global payments and fund transfers, corporate finance and treasury management, and expanding the global connectivity of Dunamu's Ethereum Layer 2 network GIWA. No commercial terms or launch timeline were given; both sides are still assessing technical and commercial feasibility. The move adds to South Korea's stablecoin infrastructure push as its Digital Asset Basic Act moves forward.

title.zh: 六大公链组织联名致信SEC，要求将“数字商品”定义写入拟议加密规则正文
title.en: Six blockchain groups urge SEC to codify digital commodity definition in binding rule text

summary.zh: Chainlink Labs、Cardano基金会、Hedera、Aptos Labs、Ava Labs与Stellar发展基金会10月20日联名向美国证券交易委员会（SEC）提交意见信，要求把“数字商品”（digital commodity）作为非证券的定义直接写入《拟议加密资产规则》（Regulation Crypto Assets）的正文条款，而非留在序言与解读性指引中。信中认为，仅靠解释性指引难以给出长期确定性，开发者需要绑定性规则保障。意见提交日恰逢该规则公众评论期截止。
summary.en: Chainlink Labs, the Cardano Foundation, Hedera, Aptos Labs, Ava Labs and the Stellar Development Foundation jointly wrote to the US SEC on October 20, urging it to write the definition of a "digital commodity" as a non-security into the operative text of its proposed Regulation Crypto Assets, rather than leaving it in the preamble and interpretive guidance. The groups argue that interpretive guidance alone cannot provide lasting certainty for builders, and the letter landed on the comment deadline for the proposed rule.

title.zh: 比特币ETF周初获5.27亿美元净流入，以太坊ETF十月流出额突破10.8亿美元创年内最大
title.en: Bitcoin ETFs draw $527M Monday inflow while Ether ETF October outflows top $1.08B, biggest of 2026

summary.zh: SoSoValue数据显示，美国现货比特币ETF周一（10月19日）净流入5.27亿美元，为9月22日以来最强单日，周二再添2300万美元，比特币守住8.3万美元附近。反观现货以太坊ETF，十月净流出已达10.8亿美元，创2026年最大单月流出并吞掉9月全部净流入，十月迄今以太币下跌9.7%至2438美元。资金明显向比特币（Bitcoin）倾斜，ETH ETF全年净流入仅剩约4.85亿美元。
summary.en: SoSoValue data shows US spot Bitcoin ETFs drew $527 million in net inflows on Monday, October 19, the strongest single day since September 22, followed by $23 million on Tuesday, with bitcoin holding near $83,000. In contrast, US spot Ether ETFs have shed $1.08 billion so far in October, the biggest monthly outflow of 2026, erasing September's entire $832 million in net inflows as ether fell 9.7% in October to $2,438. Flows are clearly favoring Bitcoin, leaving Ether ETFs with roughly $485 million in year-to-date net inflows.

title.zh: 以太坊质押占比升至35.9%创历史新高，三季度年化收益率降至2.63%
title.en: Ethereum staking hits record 35.9% of supply as Q3 annualized yield falls to 2.63%

summary.zh: Bitwise三季度报告显示，以太坊质押量达到4380万ETH，占流通总量的35.9%，创历史纪录，其中机构与企业参与者推动了质押规模的扩大。增发下行压缩了收益，平均年化质押收益率降至2.63%。分析师指出，质押率攀升锁定了流通供给，但收益下滑意味着锁仓增长未必转化为新增现货需求。Solana质押占比亦达到约69%。
summary.en: Bitwise's Q3 report shows Ethereum staking reached 43.8 million ETH, or 35.9% of total supply, a record high, driven by growing corporate and institutional participation alongside the protocol upgrade. Declining issuance compressed yields, with the average annualized staking yield falling to 2.63%. Analysts note that a high staking ratio locks up circulating supply, but falling yields mean expanding staked balances do not necessarily translate into new spot demand. Solana's staking share also reached about 69%.

title.zh: Ripple向SEC提交20页意见信支持加密规则，主张区分投资合约与代币本身
title.en: Ripple files 20-page comment letter backing SEC crypto rule, urging separation of investment contract from token

summary.zh: Ripple 10月20日向SEC提交20页意见信，公开支持拟议的《加密资产规则》（Regulation Crypto Assets），并请求明确：投资合约（investment contract）与代币本身应作区分，当发行方承诺的必要管理活动结束时，投资合约即终止。首席法务官Stuart Alderoty称公司此前诉讼已花费超1.5亿美元，并呼吁豁免二级市场的普通做市交易。评论期同日截止，SEC接下来将审议约140份意见。
summary.en: Ripple filed a 20-page comment letter with the SEC on October 20 backing its proposed Regulation Crypto Assets, asking the agency to distinguish an investment contract from the token itself, so that the contract ends once the issuer's promised managerial work is complete. Chief legal officer Stuart Alderoty said the company's earlier legal fight cost more than $150 million and urged safe treatment for ordinary secondary-market liquidity provision. The comment period closed the same day, with the SEC now weighing roughly 140 submissions.

title.zh: 瑞士FINMA批准首只面向散户的现货比特币ETF，豁免基金分散化规则
title.en: FINMA approves Switzerland's first retail spot Bitcoin ETF, exempting it from diversification rules

summary.zh: 瑞士金融市场监管局（FINMA）10月20日宣布批准该国首只面向散户投资者的现货比特币ETF，基金直接持有比特币。FINMA以比特币交易历史悠久、成交量远高于其他加密资产为由，豁免了公募基金的风险分散要求，并要求托管机构遵循其2026年1月发布的加密托管指引。FINMA未披露发行方名称，苏黎世的BIT Asset Management随后宣布获得批准，计划11月在瑞士证交所上市（代码BBIT）。
summary.en: Switzerland's Financial Market Supervisory Authority (FINMA) announced on October 20 the approval of the country's first spot Bitcoin ETF open to retail investors, with the fund holding bitcoin directly. FINMA cited bitcoin's long trading history and comparatively high volume to grant an exemption from standard fund diversification rules, while requiring custodians to follow its January 2026 crypto custody guidance. FINMA did not name the issuer; Zurich-based BIT Asset Management later claimed the approval, planning a November listing on SIX Swiss Exchange under ticker BBIT.

title.zh: DeFi Development Corp一周增持3983枚SOL，国库持仓约259万枚SOL
title.en: DeFi Development Corp adds 3,983 SOL, bringing treasury to ~2.59M SOL

summary.zh: 首家以囤积Solana为核心战略的美国上市公司DeFi Development Corp（纳斯达克代码DFDV）10月19日宣布，过去一周国库增持3983枚SOL及等价资产，总持仓达到约2590266枚SOL。同时公司宣布其分红代币CHAD的年化分红率将于11月2日起从13%上调至14%。公司表示将通过质押、验证者节点与链上国库基础设施持续复利SOL头寸。
summary.en: DeFi Development Corp (Nasdaq: DFDV), the first US public company built around a Solana accumulation strategy, announced on October 19 that its treasury added 3,983 SOL and SOL equivalents over the past week, bringing total holdings to approximately 2,590,266 SOL. The company also raised the annual dividend rate of its CHAD token from 13% to 14%, effective November 2. It said it plans to keep compounding its SOL position through staking, validator operations and onchain treasury infrastructure.

title.zh: Autheo发布THEO交易警示：跨链桥被盗170万美元后敦促用户暂停买卖与跨链
title.en: Autheo issues THEO trading advisory after $1.7M bridge exploit, urges users to halt trading and bridging

summary.zh: Autheo Network 10月17日发布安全警示，呼吁用户在调查结束前暂停THEO的买卖与跨链操作。10月12日，攻击者通过Hyperlane跨链桥上的一枚受信任中继者密钥，无授权增发了1900万枚THEO并抛售，套现约700.8枚ETH（约176万美元）后转至以太坊主网。事件导致THEO价格单日暴跌约92%，而该项目此前曾通过Halborn、CertiK等多家机构的审计。
summary.en: Autheo Network issued a security advisory on October 17 urging users to refrain from buying, selling or bridging THEO until its investigation concludes. On October 12, an attacker used a trusted relayer key on the project's Hyperlane bridge on Base to mint 19 million unbacked THEO tokens and sold them, converting the proceeds into roughly 700.8 ETH (about $1.76 million) that was then bridged to Ethereum mainnet. THEO plunged about 92% in a day, despite the project having been audited by firms including Halborn and CertiK.

title.zh: 贝莱德申请第三只比特币ETF：PBIT缓冲型基金，用IBIT期权对冲约10%下行风险
title.en: BlackRock files third Bitcoin ETF "PBIT": a buffer fund using IBIT options to cushion ~10% downside

summary.zh: 贝莱德10月19日向SEC递交初步招股书，拟发行iShares Bitcoin Managed Protection ETF（代码PBIT），这将是其继现货ETF IBIT和备兑收益型ETF BITA之后的第三只比特币基金。PBIT不直接持有比特币，而是通过买卖IBIT期权构建缓冲结构（buffer structure），目标将每期最大亏损限制在约10%，代价是放弃部分上行收益。分析人士认为，这类合规“缓冲”产品正是机构投资者入场所需的包装。
summary.en: BlackRock filed a preliminary prospectus with the SEC on October 19 for the iShares Bitcoin Managed Protection ETF (ticker PBIT), its third Bitcoin ETF after the spot IBIT and the call-writing BITA. PBIT would hold no bitcoin directly; instead it would use overlapping call option spreads on IBIT to build a defined-outcome buffer structure, targeting a maximum loss of about 10% per tranche while capping upside. Analysts say such a compliance-friendly buffer wrapper is exactly what some institutional allocators need before they can touch bitcoin at all.

title.zh: 比特币跌破8.2万美元：亚洲芯片股重挫拖累风险资产，现货ETF却创近一个月最大流入
title.en: Bitcoin slips toward $81,400 as Asian chip stocks tumble; US spot ETFs post biggest inflow in nearly a month

summary.zh: 比特币周二跌至约8.14万美元，韩国KOSPI重挫3.73%凸显科技股疲软带来的风险厌恶（risk-off）情绪。讽刺的是，美国现货比特币ETF周一反而录得5.266亿美元净流入，为近一个月最大单日流入，其中贝莱德IBIT独揽6.652亿美元。与之形成对比的是，以太坊ETF净流出1.033亿美元，已连续第四个交易日失血。资金向比特币的“避风港化”集中非常明显。
summary.en: Bitcoin slipped to about $81,400 on Tuesday as South Korea's Kospi plunged 3.73% on AI-spending worries, dragging risk assets lower. In a twist, US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $526.6 million of net inflows on Monday — their biggest day in nearly a month — with BlackRock's IBIT alone pulling in $665.2 million. Spot Ether ETFs, in contrast, shed $103.3 million, extending their losing streak to four sessions. The data shows a sharp concentration of institutional demand in bitcoin specifically.

title.zh: Drift Protocol黑客沉寂两月后行动：将13,400至25,700枚ETH转入Tornado Cash洗钱
title.en: Drift exploiter resurfaces after two months idle, sending 13,400–25,700 ETH into Tornado Cash

summary.zh: 与4月Drift Protocol攻击（损失约2.95亿美元）相关的钱包10月20日结束约两个月的沉寂，开始将窃取的ETH转入Tornado Cash混币器。Onchain Lens与Lookonchain追踪到的金额在13,400枚（约3,200万美元）到25,700枚（约6,100万美元）之间，攻击者地址仍持有约81,400枚ETH（约1.94亿美元）。这是继7月之后该资金的第二次大规模洗钱尝试，Mandiant此前将其归因于朝鲜黑客组织UNC6862。
summary.en: Wallets linked to the April Drift Protocol attack (~$295 million lost) woke up on Oct 20 after about two months of silence and began moving stolen ETH into the Tornado Cash mixer. Onchain Lens and Lookonchain tracked between 13,400 ETH (~$32M) and 25,700 ETH (~$61M) entering the mixer over two hours; the exploiter's addresses still hold about 81,400 ETH (~$194M). It is the second major laundering attempt for these funds after July. Mandiant previously attributed the attack to North Korean group UNC6862.

title.zh: 以太坊Glamsterdam升级10月26日登陆Hoodi测试网，区块Gas上限翻倍至2亿
title.en: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade goes live on the Hoodi testnet Oct 26, doubling the block gas limit to 200M

summary.zh: 以太坊基金会确认，Glamsterdam硬分叉（hard fork）将于10月26日17:42 UTC在Hoodi测试网激活，届时区块Gas上限将提升至2亿，为此前在Sepolia测试网运行过的同等参数。这是主网部署前最后一个公开测试步骤，但主网激活日期仍未确定。ETH目前在约2,380美元附近交投，距离9月底高点仍有约15%差距。
summary.en: The Ethereum Foundation confirmed that the Glamsterdam hard fork will activate on the Hoodi testnet on October 26 at 17:42 UTC, raising the block gas limit to 200 million — the same parameters already exercised on Sepolia earlier this month. Hoodi is the final public test step before developers commit to a mainnet slot, though no mainnet date has been set. ETH trades near $2,380, roughly 15% below its late-September peak.

title.zh: Solana今日激活Alpenglow共识升级：交易终局时间将从12.8秒缩短至150毫秒
title.en: Solana activates the Alpenglow consensus upgrade today, cutting finality from 12.8s to 150ms

summary.zh: Solana自2020年沿用的TowerBFT共识机制今天将被Alpenglow取代，目标是将交易终局时间（finality）压缩到150毫秒，验证人需运行兼容客户端并注册BLS密钥。升级引入了每epoch 0.8 SOL的验证人准入费，取代原有链上投票费结构。据SolanaFloor数据，截至10月20日仍有约20.3%的质押份额标记为“未就绪”，激活过程是否顺畅成为短期最大看点。
summary.en: Solana is replacing its TowerBFT consensus mechanism — in use since 2020 — with Alpenglow today, targeting transaction finality of 150 milliseconds. Validators must run compatible software and register BLS keys; the upgrade also introduces a 0.8 SOL per-epoch validator admission fee replacing the existing on-chain voting fee structure. Data cited by SolanaFloor shows roughly 20.3% of staked tokens were still marked unready on Oct 20, making a smooth activation the key near-term watch point.

title.zh: Solana链上代币化股票持有人突破140万地址，三季度非投票交易量达89.2亿笔创新高
title.en: Solana tokenized equity holders pass 1.4M addresses; Q3 non-vote transactions hit a record 8.92B

summary.zh: Solana官方X账号10月19日公布，链上持有代币化股票（tokenized equity）的地址数已突破140万个，自9月初以来增长加速。另据Allium数据，第三季度非投票交易量（non-vote transactions，更接近真实用户需求）达89.2亿笔，环比增长24%，较2025年第四季度翻了一倍以上，创季度新高。不过，自动化交易机器人贡献了相当比例的链上活动，活跃用户数与交易笔数并不等同。
summary.en: Solana's official X account reported on Oct 19 that addresses holding tokenized equities on the network passed 1.4 million, with growth accelerating since early September. Allium data shows non-vote transactions — a closer proxy for real user demand — reached 8.92 billion in Q3, up 24% quarter-over-quarter and more than double Q4 2025's level, a new quarterly record. A caveat: automated trading bots account for a significant share of on-chain activity, so transaction counts do not equal user counts.

title.zh: SEC加密资产新规意见征集期结束：收到约140条评论，CLARITY法案流产后SEC继续推进
title.en: SEC's "Regulation Crypto Assets" comment period ends with ~140 submissions; agency advances after CLARITY Act failure

summary.zh: SEC的《加密资产监管规则》（Regulation Crypto Assets）10月20日正式结束公众意见征集，共收到约140条评论。拟议规则允许加密初创公司在特定条件下筹集最高5,000万美元而无需完整证券注册，并设立代币“去证券化”安全港（safe harbor）。在CLARITY法案参议院受挫后，主席Paul Atkins表示SEC将依据现有职权继续推进加密框架。Hyperliquid Policy Center等业界组织已提交修改建议，要求澄清五个条款。
summary.en: The SEC's "Regulation Crypto Assets" proposal closed its 60-day public comment period on Oct 20 with roughly 140 submissions. The draft would let crypto startups raise up to $50 million under lighter disclosure conditions and create a conditional safe harbor for tokens to exit "investment contract" status. After the CLARITY Act stalled in the Senate, Chair Paul Atkins said the agency will press ahead under existing authority. Industry groups including the Hyperliquid Policy Center have filed comments seeking revisions to five provisions.

title.zh: Google更新阿联酋加密广告政策：10月21日起须持本地牌照并通过谷歌认证
title.en: Google tightens UAE crypto ad rules from Oct 21: local licence plus Google certification required

summary.zh: 谷歌宣布，10月21日起，面向阿联酋用户的加密货币交易所和软件钱包广告，必须持有CMA、DFSA、FSRA或VARA四家监管机构之一的牌照，并通过谷歌Ads认证（认证账户将标记“Eligible (Limited)”）。规则适用于全球所有投放阿联酋市场的账户。此举延续了谷歌与各地监管对齐的路线：ICO、DeFi交易协议和未持牌产品的广告依然被禁止。
summary.en: Google announced that from October 21, 2026, ads for crypto exchanges and software wallets targeting UAE users must hold a licence from one of four authorities — the CMA, DFSA, FSRA or VARA — and complete Google Ads certification (compliant accounts will show an "Eligible (Limited)" status). The policy applies to all accounts worldwide advertising to the UAE. It continues Google's alignment with local regulators: ICO, DeFi-protocol and unlicensed-product ads remain prohibited.

title.zh: Cysic跨链桥被黑：攻击者伪造消息在BNB链铸造1,000万枚CYS，约72.7万美元流入以太坊
title.en: Cysic bridge exploited: attacker forged messages to mint 10M CYS on BNB Chain; ~$727K moved to Ethereum

summary.zh: 10月17日，攻击者通过未经授权访问桥接服务的数据库、利用消息处理逻辑漏洞，在BNB智能链上伪造铸造了1,000万枚CYS代币。Cysic在76分钟后拉黑收款地址，冻结了剩余的280万枚，但约720万枚已被出售，约306.6 ETH（价值约72.7万美元）被转移到以太坊。项目方称主网及用户钱包资产未受影响，跨链桥在安全审查期间保持暂停。
summary.en: On Oct 17, an attacker exploited a message-processing vulnerability in Cysic's cross-chain bridge after gaining unauthorized access to a supporting database, minting 10 million unauthorized CYS tokens on BNB Chain. Cysic blacklisted the recipient address 76 minutes later, freezing the remaining 2.8 million CYS — but about 7.2 million had already been sold, with roughly 306.6 ETH (~$727,000) moved to Ethereum. The project says its mainnet and user wallets were unaffected; the bridge stays paused pending a security review.

title.zh: Ledger供应链攻击：硬件钱包被植入间谍芯片经马来西亚经销商流出，损失超9,000万美元
title.en: Ledger supply-chain attack: spy chips hidden in hardware wallets sold via Malaysian retailer; losses exceed $90M

summary.zh: Ledger披露，有组织犯罪集团在经马来西亚经销商CryptoBilis售出的部分Ledger设备中植入了隐蔽芯片。当用户在屏幕上设置助记词（recovery phrase）时，芯片会识别并解码助记词，再通过内置eSIM经LTE无线传出，使攻击者得以清空钱包。区块链研究人员估计损失超过9,000万美元。Ledger已要求港澳及东南亚零售商停售相关设备，OneKey和Trezor也开始审查部分经销商渠道。
summary.en: Ledger disclosed that a highly organized criminal group implanted covert chips inside some Ledger devices sold via Malaysian retailer CryptoBilis. When users set up the device and the recovery phrase appeared on screen, the chip recognized and decoded the words, then transmitted them via LTE using a built-in eSIM — letting attackers drain the wallets remotely. Blockchain researchers estimate losses above $90 million. Ledger has asked retailers in Hong Kong, Macau and Southeast Asia to halt sales of affected devices, and OneKey and Trezor are also reviewing reseller channels.

title.zh: Bitmine再购1.25万枚ETH：持仓达604万枚，逼近总供应量5%目标
title.en: Bitmine adds 12,535 ETH, lifting holdings to 6.04M — 99% of the way to 5% of supply

summary.zh: 由 Tom Lee 担任董事长的 Bitmine Immersion Technologies 上周再度买入12,535枚以太坊（约3,000万美元），总持仓升至6,041,481枚 ETH，约占流通量的4.9%，距离其“5%供应量”目标（Alchemy of 5%）仅一步之遥。公司表示该仓位价值约143亿美元，其每周持续买入的节奏已延续超过14个月，是目前最大的企业以太坊财库。
summary.en: Bitmine Immersion Technologies, chaired by Tom Lee, bought another 12,535 ETH worth roughly $30 million last week, lifting total holdings to 6,041,481 ETH — about 4.9% of Ethereum's supply and 99% of the way to its self-set "Alchemy of 5%" goal. The stake is valued at roughly $14.3 billion. The company's weekly accumulation streak, unbroken since launching its treasury strategy in mid-2025, makes it the largest corporate ETH treasury.

title.zh: 现货比特币与以太坊ETF上周净流出5.49亿美元，以太坊10月流出逼近10亿美元
title.en: Spot Bitcoin and Ether ETFs see $549M weekly net outflows; October ETH outflows near $1B

summary.zh: 美国现货比特币与以太坊ETF（Spot ETF）上周合计净流出约5.49亿美元，其中比特币ETF净流出2.29亿美元、以太坊ETF净流出3.2亿美元（数据来源：SoSoValue）。这是比特币ETF连续第二周净流出、以太坊ETF连续第三周净流出，不过相比前一周12.2亿美元的流出规模已明显放缓；以太坊现货ETF的10月累计净流出约9.55亿美元，为今年单月最高。尽管近期承压，两类ETF今年以来的累计净流入仍为正值。
summary.en: U.S. spot Bitcoin and Ether ETFs recorded about $549 million in combined net outflows last week, per SoSoValue data — roughly $229 million from Bitcoin funds and $320 million from Ether funds. It was the second straight red week for Bitcoin ETFs and the third for Ether funds, though outflows eased from the previous week's $1.22 billion. Spot Ether ETFs have now seen around $955 million in net outflows so far in October, the heaviest monthly total of 2026, while both ETF categories remain net positive year-to-date.

title.zh: SEC加密资产提案公众意见征询于10月20日截止，市场结构法案前途未卜
title.en: SEC's Regulation Crypto Assets comment window closes Oct 20 as CLARITY bill stalls

summary.zh: 美国证监会（SEC）的《加密资产条例》（Regulation Crypto Assets，S7-2026-27）提案公众意见征询期将于10月20日截止，为 GENIUS 法案稳定币合规框架2027年1月生效前的最后一道公开程序。该提案建立了将支付型稳定币（Payment Stablecoins）排除在证券定义之外的分类体系，截止前夕 Hyperliquid 政策中心等行业机构已密集提交意见。国会层面的《CLARITY法案》（数字资产市场结构法案）依然停滞，SEC 在国会立法缺位下推进自身规则路径。
summary.en: The SEC's proposed Regulation Crypto Assets (S7-2026-27) rulemaking closes its public comment period on October 20 — the last formal window before the GENIUS Act stablecoin compliance framework takes effect in January 2027. The proposal establishes a taxonomy that excludes payment stablecoins from the definition of a security, and drew last-minute comment letters including from the Hyperliquid Policy Center. In Congress, the CLARITY market-structure bill remains stalled, with the SEC advancing its own rulebook workaround.

title.zh: Strive与Strategy合计增持1490枚比特币，Strategy扩大STRC回购计划至30亿美元
title.en: Strive and Strategy buy 1,490 BTC combined; Strategy expands STRC buyback program to $3B

summary.zh: 企业比特币财库（Bitcoin Treasury）公司 Strive 与 Strategy 本周一同步披露增持：Strive 以均价81,734美元购入1,223枚比特币，总持仓达36,818枚；Strategy 则以约2,210万美元买入267枚，均价82,900美元，总持仓升至848,517枚。Strategy 同时将其数字信贷证券回购授权从20亿美元扩大至30亿美元，并以1.93亿美元回购了部分高息优先股（STRC），显示其资本配置重心正从直接购币转向回购低于票面价值（Par）的优先股。
summary.en: Corporate bitcoin treasury firms Strive and Strategy disclosed new purchases on Monday: Strive bought 1,223 BTC at an average of $81,734, lifting holdings to 36,818 BTC, while Strategy added 267 BTC for about $22.1 million at $82,900 each, taking its total to 848,517 BTC. Strategy also expanded its digital credit securities repurchase authorization to $3 billion from $2 billion and bought back $193 million of its high-yield preferred stock STRC, signaling a capital allocation tilt toward repurchasing preferred shares trading below par.

title.zh: Qubic因弱钱包种子被盗约140万美元，网络暂停运行
title.en: Qubic halts network after weak wallet seeds let attacker drain ~$1.4M

summary.zh: 一层区块链（Layer-1）Qubic 在攻击者利用弱随机数生成的钱包种子（Weak Wallet Seeds）从1,404个钱包中盗走约2.94万亿枚 QU（约140万美元）后暂停了网络运行，停于区块高度 tick 85,371,949。受影响的是通过 iPhone/iPad 浏览器、Mac 版 Safari 或旧版 iOS 应用创建的钱包；项目方已用加密安全的随机数函数修复该缺陷（v4.26.4）。约87.1%的被盗资金被冻结在链上，其余流向 MEXC 交易所的部分也被冻结，网络重启时间未定。
summary.en: Layer-1 blockchain Qubic halted operations after an attacker exploited weakly generated wallet seeds to drain about 2.94 trillion QU (roughly $1.4 million) from 1,404 wallets, freezing the network at tick 85,371,949. Affected seeds were generated via browsers on iPhones/iPads, Safari on Mac, or older Qubic iOS app versions; the project fixed the flaw (v4.26.4) by replacing Math.random() with a cryptographically secure random function. About 87.1% of drained funds were frozen on-chain and the rest frozen at the MEXC exchange; no restart date has been announced.

title.zh: Metaplanet进军美国资本市场：Super League股东批准2100枚比特币交易
title.en: Metaplanet moves toward U.S. listing as Super League shareholders approve 2,100 BTC deal

summary.zh: 纳斯达克上市公司 Super League Enterprise 股东批准了与日本比特币财库公司 Metaplanet 的交易提案，Metaplanet 将注入2,100枚比特币与250万美元现金，换取约4,486万股普通股、优先股与认股权证，交易完成后控股约93.7%。交易完成后 Super League 将更名为 Superplanet、股票代码改为 SUPA，成为 Metaplanet 在美国上市的比特币财库平台，目标是提升每股比特币持有量（BTC per share）；交易尚待纳斯达克相关备案等收尾条件。
summary.en: Shareholders of Nasdaq-listed Super League Enterprise approved proposals tied to Japanese bitcoin treasury company Metaplanet's investment, under which Metaplanet will contribute 2,100 BTC and $2.5 million in cash for about 44.86 million common shares plus preferred stock and warrants, giving it roughly 93.7% ownership. Super League will be renamed Superplanet and trade under the ticker SUPA, becoming Metaplanet's U.S.-listed bitcoin treasury platform aimed at growing bitcoin per share. Closing remains subject to customary conditions including Nasdaq filings.

title.zh: DFDV增持3983枚SOL至259万枚，CHAD优先股股息上调至14%
title.en: DFDV adds 3,983 SOL to reach 2.59M treasury; raises CHAD dividend rate to 14%

summary.zh: 纳斯达克上市的 Solana 财库公司 DeFi Development Corp（DFDV）上周增持3,983枚 SOL 及等值资产，财库总量达到约2,590,266枚，继续通过质押与验证节点运营获取收益。公司同时宣布将其可变利率 C 系列优先股（CHAD）的年股息率从13%上调至14%，11月2日生效，每股年派息由1.30美元升至1.40美元。公司表示未来优先股发行所得将主要用于进一步增持 SOL。
summary.en: Nasdaq-listed Solana treasury firm DeFi Development Corp (DFDV) added 3,983 SOL and equivalents last week, bringing its treasury to about 2,590,266 SOL, which it deploys through staking and validator operations. The company raised the annual dividend rate on its variable-rate Series C preferred stock (CHAD) from 13% to 14%, effective November 2, lifting the annual payout to $1.40 per share from $1.30. DFDV said proceeds from future CHAD issuances will be used primarily to accumulate more SOL.

title.zh: Glamsterdam升级定于10月26日激活Hoodi测试网，Gas上限升至2亿
title.en: Glamsterdam set for Hoodi testnet activation on Oct 26 with 200M gas limit

summary.zh: 以太坊基金会（Ethereum Foundation）宣布，Glamsterdam 升级将于10月26日17:42（UTC）在 Hoodi 测试网 epoch 132,352 激活，这是继10月6日 Sepolia 之后、主网前的最后一个公共测试网部署。升级核心包括内嵌的提议者-构建者分离（Enshrined Proposer-Builder Separation, ePBS）与区块级访问列表（Block-Level Access Lists），并将区块 Gas 上限从6,000万提升至2亿。主网激活时间尚未公布，主网用户与持币人无需采取行动。
summary.en: The Ethereum Foundation announced that the Glamsterdam upgrade will activate on the Hoodi testnet at epoch 132,352 on October 26, 2026 at 17:42 UTC — the final public testnet deployment after Sepolia's October 6 activation. Headline features include enshrined proposer-builder separation (ePBS) and block-level access lists, plus a gas limit rise from 60 million to 200 million. No mainnet date has been set, and mainnet users and holders need take no action.

title.zh: Starknet就转型独立抗量子一层链启动社区投票
title.en: Starknet launches vote on exploring an independent post-quantum Layer 1

summary.zh: Starknet 社区启动了为期七天的非约束性（Non-binding）治理投票，询问 STRK 持有者是否支持研究将 Starknet 从以太坊二层网络（Layer 2）转型为独立的抗量子一层链（Post-Quantum Layer 1），投票将于10月22日截止。StarkWare 表示，其 STARK 证明本身抗量子，但依赖以太坊的跨链桥与数据可用性仍是量子安全短板。投赞成票仅代表支持进一步研究，并不批准迁移；STRK 仍将是唯一代币，以太坊跨链桥保持开放。
summary.en: The Starknet community opened a seven-day non-binding governance vote asking STRK holders whether to research transitioning Starknet from an Ethereum Layer 2 into an independent post-quantum Layer 1, closing October 22. StarkWare says its STARK proofs are already quantum-resistant, but Ethereum-dependent components like its bridge and data availability remain quantum-security gaps. A "Yes" vote only authorizes further research — not a migration — and STRK would remain the native token with Ethereum bridges staying open.

title.en: Saylor teases another Bitcoin buy as Strategy hoard reaches 848,250 BTC
title.zh: Saylor 再发购币暗示：Strategy 持仓已达 848,250 枚 BTC

summary.en: Michael Saylor posted his recurring 'we found room for more orange' chart update on X on October 18, teasing another Strategy Bitcoin purchase. The company's dashboard shows 848,250 BTC held — about 4.04% of the 21 million supply — worth roughly $69.45 billion at an average cost of $75,444 per coin. The tease comes as reported weekly purchases have slowed: the latest reporting week saw only 250 BTC bought while $192.4 million went to STRC preferred-share buybacks.
summary.zh: Michael Saylor 于 10 月 18 日在 X 发布其惯例的“we found room for more orange”持仓图表，暗示 Strategy 将再次买入比特币。公司仪表盘显示其持有 848,250 枚 BTC（约占 2100 万供应总量的 4.04%），价值约 694.5 亿美元，平均成本为每枚 75,444 美元。值得注意的是，公司近期周度购币节奏放缓：最新报告周仅买入 250 枚 BTC，同时将 1.924 亿美元用于回购 STRC 优先股（preferred shares）。

title.en: Cysic suspends bridge after attacker mints 10 million CYS on BNB Chain
title.zh: Cysic 遭攻击：攻击者在 BNB Chain 未经授权铸造 1000 万枚 CYS，跨链桥暂停

summary.en: The Cysic Foundation said on October 18 that an attacker exploited unauthorized database access and a bridge message-processing flaw to mint 10 million CYS on BNB Chain on October 17. On-chain tracking shows the attacker sold about 7.2 million CYS and moved roughly 306.6 ETH (about $727,000) to Ethereum before Cysic blacklisted the receiving address, freezing the remaining 2.8 million CYS. The project says the incident did not affect the Cysic mainnet or existing user assets, and the bridge stays closed until a security review is complete.
summary.zh: Cysic 基金会于 10 月 18 日披露，攻击者于 10 月 17 日利用未经授权的数据库访问与跨链桥消息处理漏洞，在 BNB Chain 上非法铸造 1000 万枚 CYS。链上追踪显示，攻击者在 Cysic 拉黑（blacklist）相关地址前卖出约 720 万枚 CYS，并将约 306.6 枚 ETH（约 72.7 万美元）转移至以太坊（Ethereum）；剩余约 280 万枚 CYS 已被冻结。项目方称事件未波及 Cysic 主网及现有用户资产，跨链桥在安全审查完成前保持关闭。

title.en: Spot Solana ETF outflows extend to ten straight sessions; SOL tests $100
title.zh: 美国现货 SOL ETF 净流出延续至第十个交易日，SOL 考验 100 美元关口

summary.en: U.S. spot Solana ETFs recorded about $12.7 million in net outflows on October 16, their tenth consecutive session of withdrawals, with Bitwise's BSOL accounting for the entire day's exit. Across October 12–16 the funds lost about $25.5 million, though cumulative net inflows still stand near $1.55 billion. SOL slipped to about $103 as traders reduced futures exposure and watched the $100 support level.
summary.zh: 美国现货 SOL ETF 于 10 月 16 日录得约 1270 万美元净流出，为连续第十个交易日净赎回，当日流出全部来自 Bitwise 的 BSOL 产品。10 月 12–16 日期间上述基金累计净流出约 2550 万美元，不过累计净流入仍维持在约 15.5 亿美元。SOL 随之跌至约 103 美元，交易员削减期货敞口，并关注 100 美元支撑位。

title.en: Bitcoin holds near $81,500 in quiet weekend trading; $82,800 in focus for weekly close
title.zh: 比特币周末交投清淡守住 81,500 美元附近，周线收盘聚焦 82,800 美元

summary.en: Bitcoin traded around $81,500 through the weekend in thin liquidity, with technical indicators giving mixed signals: shorter-term moving averages favor sellers while the longer-term structure still supports buyers. Analysts cited $82,800 as the weekly-close level needed to open a path toward $90,000, while a loss of $80,000 could invite a deeper slide. Bitcoin dominance rose to about 60%, signaling defensive positioning as altcoins underperformed.
summary.zh: 比特币在流动性清淡的周末守住 81,500 美元附近，技术指标信号分化：短期均线偏向空方，长期结构仍支撑多方。分析师认为，周线收盘站上 82,800 美元方可打开通往 90,000 美元的空间；若跌破 80,000 美元则可能引发更深回调。随着山寨币走弱，比特币市占率升至约 60%，显示资金转向防御。

title.en: Spot Bitcoin ETFs post $82.4M outflows on October 16 as Ethereum funds shed $69.7M
title.zh: 10 月 16 日美国现货 BTC ETF 净流出 8240 万美元，ETH ETF 净流出 6970 万美元

summary.en: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $82.39 million in net outflows on October 16, led by BlackRock's IBIT with $71.78 million in redemptions; Ethereum ETFs lost $69.68 million the same day, entirely from BlackRock's ETHA. The outflows mark a third consecutive losing week for Ethereum products, with roughly $1 billion withdrawn over the three weeks ending October 16. Bitcoin funds remain near $105–106 billion in total assets, so the daily outflow was less than 0.1% of assets.
summary.zh: 美国现货比特币 ETF 于 10 月 16 日录得 8239 万美元净流出，其中贝莱德（BlackRock）IBIT 占 7178 万美元；同日以太坊 ETF 净流出 6968 万美元，全部来自贝莱德 ETHA。此为以太坊产品连续第三周净流出，截至 10 月 16 日的三周累计流出约 10 亿美元。比特币 ETF 总资产仍接近 1050–1060 亿美元，单日流出不足资产规模的 0.1%。

title.en: ECB confirms digital euro plans as Lagarde flags 3.8% euro-area inflation
title.zh: 欧洲央行确认数字欧元（digital euro）计划，拉加德称欧元区通胀达 3.8%

summary.en: ECB President Christine Lagarde confirmed at the IMF Annual Meetings on October 17 that the ECB is preparing a digital euro to complement cash in retail payments, aiming to stimulate innovation and competition while preserving Europe's payments autonomy. The ECB plans a 12-month internal pilot in the second half of 2027, with a first possible issuance in 2029, subject to EU legislation. Lagarde also said September's 3.8% euro-area inflation largely reflected high energy costs expected to ease next year.
summary.zh: 欧洲央行行长拉加德（Christine Lagarde）于 10 月 17 日在 IMF 年会上确认，欧洲央行正筹备数字欧元（digital euro）以在零售支付中补充现金，目标是促进创新与竞争、维护欧洲支付自主权。欧洲央行计划 2027 年下半年开展为期 12 个月的内部试点，并以欧盟立法通过为前提，最早于 2029 年首次发行。拉加德还表示，9 月欧元区 3.8% 的通胀率主要反映能源成本高企，预计明年缓解。

title.en: France's National Assembly narrowly votes to tax crypto-to-stablecoin swaps at 31.4%
title.zh: 法国国民议会以 38 比 37 通过修正案：加密资产兑换稳定币将按 31.4% 征税

summary.en: France's National Assembly voted 38–37 on October 16 to adopt Amendment I-3898 to the 2027 Finance Bill, which would make swaps of volatile crypto into MiCA-defined fiat-pegged stablecoins a taxable event from January 1, 2027. The measure ends the deferral that let French investors rotate into stablecoins tax-free until cashing out to euros, applying the flat 31.4% digital-asset gains rate. The text still needs Senate review; Public Accounts Minister David Amiel opposed it, citing tracking complexity.
summary.zh: 法国国民议会于 10 月 16 日以 38 票对 37 票通过 2027 年财政法案修正案 I-3898，拟自 2027 年 1 月 1 日起，将加密资产兑换为 MiCA 定义的法定货币挂钩稳定币视为应税事件。该修正案终结了法国投资者在兑换为欧元前可免税转入稳定币的递延政策，适用 31.4% 的数字资产统一资本利得税率（flat rate）。修正案仍需参议院审议；公共账务部长 David Amiel 以追踪复杂为由表示反对。

title.en: Fed Chair Warsh stays tight-lipped on rates; October hike odds collapse
title.zh: 美联储主席 Warsh 对利率路径三缄其口，10 月加息概率骤降

summary.en: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh declined to give forward guidance at an economic conference in Bangkok on October 16, saying 'it’s a new chapter at the Fed, and we’re not in that business anymore.' Markets read it as a signal the Fed will hold on October 28: CME FedWatch odds of a hold jumped above 85%, while Polymarket put no-change odds at 87%. Warsh acknowledged inflation pressures remain uncomfortable and that central banks globally are tightening in sync, leaving December as the next open decision point.
summary.zh: 美联储主席 Kevin Warsh 于 10 月 16 日在曼谷一场经济会议上拒绝给出前瞻指引（forward guidance），称“这是美联储的新篇章，我们不再做这项业务”。市场将其解读为 10 月 28 日议息会议将按兵不动：CME FedWatch 显示维持利率不变的概率升至 85% 以上，Polymarket 的无变动赔率达 87%。Warsh 同时承认通胀压力仍令人不安、全球央行正同步收紧，12 月将是下一个开放的决策窗口。

title.en: Solana sets October 21 activation for Alpenglow, targeting ~150ms finality
title.zh: Solana 敲定 Alpenglow 于 10 月 21 日激活，目标实现约 150 毫秒最终确认

summary.en: Solana will activate Alpenglow, its largest consensus overhaul, at the start of epoch 1064 around 15:00 UTC on October 21, replacing TowerBFT. The upgrade targets transaction finality of about 150 milliseconds, down from roughly 12.8 seconds today, by moving validator votes off-chain into direct message exchange with certificates. Validators must run Agave 4.3.0 or later; each vote account must hold 0.8 SOL above its rent-exempt balance under the new Validator Admission Ticket.
summary.zh: Solana 将于 10 月 21 日约 15:00（UTC）在 epoch 1064 起始处激活 Alpenglow——其历史上最大规模的共识机制改革，以取代 TowerBFT。该升级通过将验证者投票转为链下直连消息并聚合成证书（certificates），目标是将交易最终确认（finality）从当前约 12.8 秒降至约 150 毫秒。验证者需运行 Agave 4.3.0 及以上版本，且每个投票账户需在租金豁免余额之外持有 0.8 枚 SOL（Validator Admission Ticket 新规）。

title.en: Babylon Labs proposes native Bitcoin collateral for Aave V4
title.zh: Babylon Labs 提案：将原生比特币（native BTC）引入 Aave V4 作为抵押品

summary.en: Babylon Labs published an ARFC on the Aave governance forum on October 14 proposing native Bitcoin as collateral on Aave V4 through Trustless Bitcoin Vaults. BTC would be locked in Taproot-based arrangements on the Bitcoin network, with Aave recording restricted collateral units inside a dedicated market — no wrapping or custodian required. The proposal remains at the governance-comment stage; risk parameters, a Snapshot vote and an on-chain proposal are still ahead.
summary.zh: Babylon Labs 于 10 月 14 日在 Aave 治理论坛发布 ARFC 提案，拟通过“无信任比特币金库”（Trustless Bitcoin Vaults, TBV）将原生比特币引入 Aave V4 作为抵押品。BTC 将锁定在比特币网络上的 Taproot 脚本安排中，Aave 则在专用市场内记录受限抵押单元——无需封装（wrapping）或托管。该提案目前处于治理评论阶段，风险参数、Snapshot 投票与链上提案尚待推进。

title.en: Standard Chartered opens direct Bitcoin and Ether trading to UAE wealth clients
title.zh: 渣打银行向阿联酋财富客户开放比特币与以太币直接交易

summary.en: Standard Chartered launched direct Bitcoin and Ether trading for affluent UAE clients on October 14, becoming the first international bank to offer such a service in the UAE. Eligible professional investors can trade BTC and ETH through their existing bank accounts, with custody and settlement kept inside the bank's closed-loop system built with Zodia Markets. The service is regulated by Dubai's Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority (VARA).
summary.zh: 渣打银行（Standard Chartered）于 10 月 14 日向阿联酋财富客户推出比特币与以太币直接交易服务，成为首家在阿联酋提供此类服务的国际银行。符合条件的专业投资者（professional investors）可通过现有银行账户直接交易 BTC 与 ETH，托管与结算由银行闭环系统内部完成，技术方案由 Zodia Markets 提供。该服务受迪拜虚拟资产监管局（VARA）监管。

title.en: Cantor Fitzgerald raises 12-month Bitcoin assumption to $112,000, lifts Strategy target to $208
title.zh: Cantor Fitzgerald 将 12 个月比特币预期上调至 11.2 万美元，Strategy 目标价升至 208 美元

summary.en: Cantor Fitzgerald raised its 12-month Bitcoin price assumption to $112,000 from $98,000 on Oct 16, and lifted its Strategy (MSTR) share-price target to $208 from $186 while keeping an Overweight rating. The $112,000 figure feeds directly into its valuation model for Strategy, which holds 848,250 BTC; its enterprise-value estimate rose to $110 billion from $97 billion. The call implies roughly 37% upside from Bitcoin's ~$81,000 market price.
summary.zh: Cantor Fitzgerald 于 10 月 16 日将 12 个月比特币价格预期从 98,000 美元上调至 112,000 美元，同时将 Strategy（MSTR）股票目标价从 186 美元上调至 208 美元，维持增持（Overweight）评级。11.2 万美元的假设直接计入其对 Strategy 的估值模型——该公司持有 848,250 枚 BTC；其企业价值（enterprise value）估计也从 970 亿美元上调至 1100 亿美元。按比特币约 81,000 美元的现价计算，该目标意味着约 37% 的上行空间。

title.en: Ether rebounds about 4% to ~$2,500 as $2,350 support holds; spot ETH ETFs extend weekly outflows
title.zh: 以太坊反弹约 4% 至 2,500 美元附近，2,350 美元支撑守住；现货 ETH ETF 延续周流出

summary.en: Ether bounced roughly 4% to around $2,500 after tapping the $2,350 support zone, with analysts flagging $2,550 as the next resistance — a weekly close above it would signal a bottom, while failure risks one more flush. Thursday saw $60.2 million leave U.S. spot Ether ETFs, putting the funds on track for a second straight week of outflows. Hot U.S. inflation data (CPI 3.7%, PPI 6.3%) and $72 million in liquidations have kept pressure on, though RSI at ~42 is not yet oversold.
summary.zh: 以太坊在测试 2,350 美元支撑后反弹约 4%，升至约 2,500 美元；分析师将 2,550 美元视为下一阻力位——若周线收于其上，将确认底部，否则仍可能再探低点。美国现货以太坊 ETF 周四（10 月 15 日）净流出 6020 万美元，正迈向连续第二周净流出。超预期的美国通胀数据（CPI 同比 3.7%、PPI 同比 6.3%）以及约 7200 万美元的爆仓（liquidations）持续压制市场，不过 RSI 约 42 尚未进入超卖区。

title.en: Bitcoin consolidates near $81,500 above 50-day average; spot ETFs post second straight weekly outflow
title.zh: 比特币在 81,500 美元附近震荡、守住 50 日均线；现货 ETF 连续第二周净流出

summary.en: Bitcoin traded near $81,500 on Oct 17, holding above its 50-day EMA around $80,428 while sitting below the 20-day EMA near $82,648, with RSI near 47 suggesting momentum has cooled since early October. U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs posted a second consecutive weekly outflow of about $228.6 million, following $681.1 million the week before, though selling slowed sharply. Bitcoin remains well above its rising 100- and 200-day averages, keeping the broader trend intact.
summary.zh: 10 月 17 日，比特币在约 81,500 美元附近交易，守住 50 日均线（约 80,428 美元）上方，但仍低于 20 日均线（约 82,648 美元）；RSI（相对强弱指数）约 47，显示动能自 10 月初以来降温。美国现货比特币 ETF 当周净流出约 2.286 亿美元，为连续第二周流出，不过抛售力度已较前一周的 6.811 亿美元明显放缓。比特币仍远高于持续上行的 100 日与 200 日均线，中期趋势暂未破坏。

title.en: Crypto ETFs bleed $611M in a week as Ether outflows outpace Bitcoin
title.zh: 加密 ETF 单周净流出 6.11 亿美元，以太坊基金流出超比特币

summary.en: U.S. spot crypto ETFs recorded about $610.7 million in net outflows for the week of Oct 12–16, with Ether funds shedding $320.1 million — outpacing Bitcoin's $228.4 million — while Solana, Zcash and Hyperliquid funds also lost money. Friday was the weakest session, with Bitcoin ETFs losing $82.39 million in a single day, led by BlackRock's IBIT, though weekly outflows still eased from the prior week's $678.9 million. Bitcoin held near $81,000, consolidating just above the $80,000 level as institutional demand wavered.
summary.zh: 美国现货加密 ETF 在 10 月 12–16 日当周净流出约 6.107 亿美元，其中以太坊基金净流出 3.201 亿美元，超过比特币基金的 2.284 亿美元；Solana、Zcash 与 Hyperliquid 相关基金同样失血。周五（10 月 16 日）为单日最弱，比特币 ETF 单日净流出 8239 万美元，主要由贝莱德 IBIT 领衔，尽管周流出规模仍较前一周的 6.789 亿美元明显收窄。比特币守在约 81,000 美元附近，在 80,000 美元上方窄幅震荡，机构需求持续摇摆。

title.en: Scammer gets scammed: Chainalysis says task-scam operator lost 60 BTC (~$4.9M) in Ledger exploit
title.zh: 骗子反被骗：Chainalysis 称某“任务诈骗”团伙在 Ledger 漏洞中损失 60 枚 BTC（约 490 万美元）

summary.en: Chainalysis said Oct 16 that a task-scam operator — who ran fake online-job schemes luring victims with 'negative balance' demands — lost 60 BTC (about $4.9 million) when attackers emptied three Ledger wallet addresses on Oct 9. The wallets used devices sold by Southeast Asian reseller CryptoBilis, which contained unauthorized hardware implants able to transmit recovery information over a mobile network. The case underscores the reach of the CryptoBilis breach and shows even criminal proceeds were swept into the same laundering chain.
summary.zh: Chainalysis 于 10 月 16 日表示，一名运营“任务诈骗”（以虚假在线兼职诱骗受害者，以“账户负余额”为由要求充值）的团伙，在 10 月 9 日被攻击者清空了三个 Ledger 钱包地址，损失 60 枚比特币（约 490 万美元）。这些钱包使用的是东南亚经销商 CryptoBilis 售出的设备，其中含有可通过移动网络传输助记词的非法硬件植入。此案凸显了 CryptoBilis 事件的波及范围，也表明连犯罪所得也被卷入同一条洗钱链条。

title.en: Solana tests $100 as U.S. SOL ETFs post record $24.8M weekly outflow ahead of Alpenglow upgrade
title.zh: Solana 考验 100 美元关口；美国 SOL ETF 单周净流出 2480 万美元创纪录，Alpenglow 升级临近

summary.en: Solana fell about 13% in October to test the $100 level as U.S. spot SOL ETFs recorded a record $24.8 million weekly outflow, ending a 14-week inflow streak; outflows stretched to eight straight days. Bitwise's BSOL accounted for most of the selling, while Solana network activity stayed firm with $3.5 billion of USDC minted on-chain in a week. The Alpenglow protocol upgrade, set for Oct 21 and changing Solana's consensus mechanism, is the next key catalyst.
summary.zh: Solana 10 月累计下跌约 13%，考验 100 美元关口；美国现货 SOL ETF 单周净流出 2480 万美元，创下纪录并终结连续 14 周的净流入，流出天数已连续 8 天。Bitwise 的 BSOL 占抛售的大部分，而 Solana 链上活动依然活跃，单周铸造 35 亿美元 USDC。定于 10 月 21 日的 Alpenglow 协议升级（将改变 Solana 共识机制）是下一个关键催化剂。

title.en: Australia's ASIC consults on up to A$14M capital bar for crypto platforms ahead of 2027 licensing
title.zh: 澳大利亚 ASIC 就加密平台最高 1400 万澳元资本要求征求意见，牌照制度 2027 年生效

summary.en: Australia's ASIC released consultation paper CP 392 on Oct 15 proposing capital, custody and trading standards for digital-asset platforms, with feedback due Nov 27 and final guidance expected in March 2027. One of three capital models would require operators without qualifying third-party custody to hold at least A$14 million in net tangible assets (or 10% of average revenue). The framework, effective April 8, 2027, also restricts proprietary trading and requires quarterly wallet reporting; ASIC has already received over 140 licensing applications.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚证券和投资委员会（ASIC）于 10 月 15 日发布 CP 392 征求意见文件，就数字资产平台的资本、托管与交易标准征求意见，截止 11 月 27 日，最终指引预计 2027 年 3 月发布。三种资本模型之一要求未采用合格第三方托管的运营商持有至少 1400 万澳元有形净资产（或年均收入的 10%，取较高者）。该框架将于 2027 年 4 月 8 日生效，还将限制自营交易并要求按季度报告客户资产钱包；ASIC 已收到超过 140 份牌照申请。

title.en: South Korea approves website blocks on 27 unregistered overseas exchanges including KuCoin and MEXC
title.zh: 韩国批准封锁 27 家未注册海外交易所网站，包括 KuCoin 与 MEXC

summary.en: South Korea's Financial Intelligence Unit announced Oct 13 that regulators approved blocking domestic access to websites of 27 unregistered overseas virtual-asset operators, including KuCoin, MEXC, Phemex, BingX and BitMart. Overseas-run sites face access blocking while domestically hosted ones face service termination, extending last year's app-store restrictions to websites. The FIU assesses whether platforms target Koreans via Korean-language services, local marketing or won payments, and warned users they could struggle to access funds.
summary.zh: 韩国金融情报室（FIU）于 10 月 13 日宣布，监管部门已批准封锁 27 家未注册海外虚拟资产运营商的网站国内访问，包括 KuCoin、MEXC、Phemex、BingX 与 BitMart。境外运营的网站将被限制访问，境内托管的网站则终止服务，相当于将去年的应用商店限制扩大到网站层面。FIU 以韩语服务、面向韩国用户的营销和韩元支付支持作为是否面向韩国运营的判断标准，并警告用户可能面临资金提取困难。

title.en: Pando Finance lists Hong Kong's second spot Solana ETF on Oct 13
title.zh: Pando Finance 于 10 月 13 日在香港上市第二只 Solana 现货 ETF

summary.en: Pando Finance listed its spot Solana ETF on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange on Oct 13 under code 02831, Hong Kong's second SOL-based spot ETF after ChinaAMC's. The fund charges a 0.6% management fee (about 1.6% in estimated annual ongoing charges), holds SOL without staking, and uses HashKey for trading and custody. It tracks the CME CF Solana-Dollar index's Asia-Pacific close, giving regional investors regulated SOL exposure through brokerage accounts.
summary.zh: Pando Finance 于 10 月 13 日在香港交易所上市其 Solana 现货 ETF（代码 02831），成为香港第二只 SOL 现货 ETF（此前为华夏基金）。该基金管理费为 0.6%（预计年度经常性开支约 1.6%），持有 SOL 但不参与质押（staking），由 HashKey 提供交易与托管服务。基金跟踪 CME CF Solana 美元指数的亚太收盘价，让地区投资者可通过券商账户获得合规的 SOL 敞口。

title.en: Ethereum's Glamsterdam Upgrade Scheduled for Hoodi Testnet on Oct 26
title.zh: 以太坊 Glamsterdam 升级定于 10 月 26 日上线 Hoodi 测试网

summary.en: The Ethereum Foundation announced that the Glamsterdam network upgrade will activate on the Hoodi testnet on October 26, 2026 at 17:42:48 UTC (epoch 132,352), following its October 6 activation on Sepolia. Glamsterdam combines the Amsterdam execution-layer upgrade with the Gloas consensus-layer upgrade, headlined by enshrined proposer-builder separation (EIP-7732) and block-level access lists (EIP-7928). The mainnet activation date has not yet been decided.
summary.zh: 以太坊基金会宣布，Glamsterdam 网络升级将于 10 月 26 日 17:42:48 UTC 在 Hoodi 测试网激活（epoch 132,352），此前已于 10 月 6 日在 Sepolia 测试网上线。该升级融合了 Amsterdam 执行层升级与 Gloas 共识层升级，核心内容包括嵌入式提议者—构建者分离（EIP-7732，enshrined proposer-builder separation）与区块级访问列表（EIP-7928，block-level access lists）。主网激活日期尚未确定。

title.en: Bitcoin rebounds toward $83,000 after inflation-driven sell-off; nearly $1B in liquidations
title.zh: 通胀数据引发抛售后，比特币反弹至接近 83,000 美元；杠杆仓位爆仓近 10 亿美元

summary.en: Bitcoin recovered to about $82,750 on October 16 after falling as low as $79,770 the previous day, when hot US inflation data (September CPI 3.7% YoY, PPI up 6.3% YoY) pushed odds of an October Fed rate hike above 50%. Roughly $950 million to $973 million in leveraged crypto positions were liquidated in the sell-off, while easing Treasury yields (10-year retreating to about 5.1%) and dip-buying helped stabilize prices. Ether also recovered, rising about 1.3% to $2,481.
summary.zh: 比特币在 10 月 16 日回升至约 82,750 美元，此前一天曾因超预期的美国通胀数据（9 月 CPI 同比 3.7%、PPI 同比上涨 6.3%）跌至 79,770 美元，美联储 10 月加息概率升破 50%。本次抛售导致约 9.5 亿至 9.73 亿美元的杠杆仓位被强制平仓（liquidations），美债收益率回落（10 年期回落至约 5.1%）与逢低买入帮助稳定了价格。以太币同样反弹，上涨约 1.3% 至 2,481 美元。

title.en: Solana's on-chain RWA value hits $4.3B, reaching 26% of Ethereum's total
title.zh: Solana 链上 RWA 市值达到 43 亿美元，相当于以太坊总量的 26%

summary.en: A Castle Labs report published October 15 found Solana's on-chain real-world asset (RWA) market value grew from about $700 million to $4.3 billion over the past year, lifting it from 4.5% to 26% of Ethereum's $16.6 billion total. Tokenized stocks were a standout, rising from $63 million to $455 million, driven by issuers such as xStocks and Backpack. The report also noted Solana led tracked networks with $193.1 million in application revenue over the past 30 days.
summary.zh: Castle Labs 于 10 月 15 日发布的报告显示，Solana 链上现实世界资产（RWA，real-world assets）市值在过去一年从约 7 亿美元增长至 43 亿美元，占以太坊 166 亿美元总量的比例从 4.5% 提升至 26%。其中代币化股票（tokenized stocks）表现突出，从 6300 万美元增至 4.55 亿美元，主要由 xStocks、Backpack 等发行方推动。报告还指出，Solana 在过去 30 天以 1.931 亿美元的应用收入领跑所追踪的公链。

title.en: SlowMist warns of fake Ledger firmware-update phishing exploiting the CryptoBilis hack
title.zh: SlowMist 警告：不法分子冒充 Ledger 固件更新页面，利用 CryptoBilis 事件实施钓鱼

summary.en: Blockchain security firm SlowMist issued a threat-intelligence alert on October 16 about phishing pages impersonating an official Ledger firmware update, exploiting panic from the CryptoBilis supply-chain incident. The fake pages replicate Ledger's 'Genuine Check' flow, device selection and an 'Update Now' button to trick users into revealing their recovery phrases. SlowMist advises never updating Ledger devices through website links and never entering a recovery phrase anywhere except the device itself.
summary.zh: 区块链安全公司 SlowMist 于 10 月 16 日发布威胁情报警报，称钓鱼页面冒充 Ledger 官方固件更新，利用 CryptoBilis 供应链事件引发的恐慌行骗。这些页面复制了 Ledger 的“Genuine Check”（真伪检测）流程、设备选择界面与“立即更新”按钮，诱导用户泄露助记词（recovery phrase）。SlowMist 建议用户切勿通过网页链接更新 Ledger 设备，也不要在设备以外的任何地方输入助记词。

title.en: XRP ETFs extend inflow streak to 13 weeks as BTC, ETH and SOL funds bleed
title.zh: XRP 现货 ETF 连续 13 周净流入，BTC、ETH、SOL 基金则持续失血

summary.en: US spot XRP ETFs have logged net inflows for 13 consecutive weeks, reaching about $1.80 billion in cumulative inflows, even as XRP net assets fell to roughly $1.57 billion on price declines. In the week ended October 9, XRP funds added $11.31 million while Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana ETFs shed a combined $1.25 billion. The streak continued even though the daily inflow slowed to about $740,000 on October 14.
summary.zh: 美国现货 XRP ETF 已连续 13 周实现净流入，累计流入约 18 亿美元，不过受币价下跌影响，净资产降至约 15.7 亿美元。截至 10 月 9 日的一周，XRP 基金净流入 1131 万美元，而同期比特币、以太坊和 Solana ETF 合计净流出 12.5 亿美元。尽管 10 月 14 日单日流入放缓至约 74 万美元，连续流入纪录仍在延续。

title.en: Ledger suspends Southeast Asia resellers after hardware implant drained ~$90M from wallets
title.zh: Ledger 在硬件植入事件盗走约 9000 万美元后，暂停东南亚经销商销售

summary.en: Ledger asked resellers and distributors in Indonesia, Singapore, Thailand, the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia and Hong Kong to suspend sales while it investigates tampered devices sold through Malaysian reseller CryptoBilis. Ledger confirmed a hardware implant in an affected device - an extra chip intercepting the 24-word seed phrase - and Bloomberg reported about $90 million stolen across Bitcoin, Ethereum and TRON wallets; on-chain tallies range from roughly $86 million to $102 million. Ledger said its own infrastructure and direct sales channel show no sign of compromise.
summary.zh: Ledger 已要求印度尼西亚、新加坡、泰国、菲律宾、越南、马来西亚和中国香港的经销商与分销商暂停销售，以配合对马来西亚经销商 CryptoBilis 售出的被篡改设备进行调查。Ledger 确认受影响设备存在硬件植入——一块用于拦截 24 词助记词（seed phrase）的额外芯片；据 Bloomberg 报道，比特币、以太坊和波场（TRON）钱包中约 9000 万美元被盗，链上统计范围约为 8600 万至 1.02 亿美元。Ledger 表示其自身基础设施与直销渠道未发现被攻破迹象。

title.en: Strategy bought 250 BTC in week ended Oct 11; holdings reach 848,250 BTC
title.zh: Strategy 在截至 10 月 11 日的一周增持 250 枚 BTC，总持仓达 848,250 枚

summary.en: Strategy disclosed on October 12 that it purchased 250 BTC for approximately $21.5 million during the week of October 5-11, at an average price of about $86,194 per coin. The addition lifts total holdings to 848,250 BTC, acquired for an aggregate cost of roughly $64 billion. The company also repurchased about $192.4 million of its STRC preferred shares over the same period.
summary.zh: Strategy 于 10 月 12 日披露，在 10 月 5 日至 11 日的一周内以约 2150 万美元买入 250 枚比特币，平均买入价约为 86,194 美元/枚。本次增持后，其总持仓达到 848,250 枚 BTC，累计成本约 640 亿美元。同期公司还回购了约 1.924 亿美元的 STRC 优先股。

title.en: Samsung Wallet to add USDC transfers on Solana for 82M US Galaxy devices
title.zh: 三星钱包将为美国 8200 万台 Galaxy 设备接入 Solana 上的 USDC 转账

summary.en: Samsung Electronics said its Wallet and Pay apps will support USDC transfers on the Solana blockchain for eligible US users starting in the last week of October, covering 82 million compatible Galaxy devices. The feature runs inside the existing Samsung Wallet interface with integrated fiat on/off-ramps, supported by Coinbase as sub-custodian and Bastion for stablecoin infrastructure. Sui is also listed as a supporting blockchain partner.
summary.zh: 三星电子表示，其 Wallet 与 Pay 应用将于 10 月最后一周起支持符合条件的美国用户在 Solana 区块链上进行 USDC 转账，覆盖 8200 万台兼容的 Galaxy 设备。该功能内置于现有三星钱包界面，集成法币出入金通道（fiat on/off-ramps），由 Coinbase 担任次级托管方（sub-custodian），Bastion 提供稳定币基础设施支持。Sui 也被列为支持的区块链合作方之一。

title.en: CFTC proposes first federal crypto trading rules after Clarity Act stalls
title.zh: 在 Clarity 法案受阻后，CFTC 推出首批联邦层面加密交易规则草案

summary.en: The US Commodity Futures Trading Commission on October 5 proposed two new rules, Regulation CTX and Regulation CAM, the first federal regulations written specifically for digital-asset trading. The rules would let crypto exchanges opt into a federal regime for margined, leveraged or financed retail crypto trades, bypassing state-by-state licensing. The move follows the Senate's failure to advance the Clarity Act market-structure bill; the public has 60 days to comment.
summary.zh: 美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）于 10 月 5 日推出两项新规 Regulation CTX 与 Regulation CAM，这是首批专门针对数字资产交易的联邦法规。该规则允许加密交易所选择加入联邦监管框架，处理面向散户的保证金、杠杆或融资加密交易，从而绕过各州逐州发牌。这一举动发生在参议院未能推进 Clarity 法案市场结构立法之后；公众有 60 天时间提交意见。

summary.en: A hotter-than-expected September US CPI briefly pushed bitcoin below $80,000 for the first time in about a month, before it rebounded toward $82,000. US spot bitcoin ETFs lost about $261 million on Wednesday, according to SoSoValue data, while ether fell roughly 5% to near $2,370 and ZEC led the losers. Traders are now watching the October 27-28 Federal Reserve meeting, with markets pricing in a 27% chance of a rate hike.
summary.zh: 美国9月CPI (Consumer Price Index) 超预期升温，比特币一度跌破80,000美元，约为一个月来首次，随后回升至82,000美元附近。据SoSoValue数据，美现货比特币ETF (Spot Bitcoin ETF) 周三净流出约2.61亿美元；以太币下跌约5%至2,370美元附近，ZEC领跌大盘。市场将目光转向10月27-28日的美联储议息会议，市场预计加息概率为27%。

title.en: Bitcoin Briefly Falls Below $80,000 Then Rebounds to ~$82,000; US Spot ETFs Shed ~$261M
title.zh: 比特币短暂跌破8万美元后反弹至约82,000美元，美现货ETF单日净流出约2.61亿美元

summary.en: Security firm Hacken's Q3 report tallied about $1.18 billion in crypto hack losses across 107 recorded incidents in the third quarter of 2026, the most damaging quarter since Q1 2025. About 77% ($906 million) stemmed from compromised suppliers or developer tools and disclosed-but-undeployed fixes, while smart-contract exploits were the most frequent attack type ($228M across 71 incidents). Roughly $387 million (33%) was returned or reversed, but $384 million remained unrecovered; four incidents (Bitget, Liquid Network, Tectonic, Coldcard) accounted for about 80% of total losses.
summary.zh: 安全公司Hacken的第三季度报告显示，2026年第三季度加密劫案共107起，损失约11.8亿美元，为自2025年一季度 (Bybit 14亿美元事件) 以来最严重的季度。其中约77% (9.06亿美元) 与受损的供应商或开发工具、已披露却未修复的漏洞有关；智能合约漏洞为最频发攻击类型 (71起，损失2.28亿美元)。约3.87亿美元 (33%) 被返还或回滚，但仍有约3.84亿美元未能追回；Bitget、Liquid Network、Tectonic与Coldcard固件漏洞四起事件占总损失的约80%。

title.en: Hacken: Q3 2026 Crypto Hacks Hit $1.18B Across 107 Incidents, Worst Quarter Since Q1 2025
title.zh: Hacken报告：2026年第三季度加密劫案损失达11.8亿美元，为2025年一季度以来最惨重

summary.en: Babylon Labs published an ARFC proposal on Aave's governance forum on October 14 to add native BTC as collateral on Aave V4 through its Trustless Bitcoin Vaults protocol. The design introduces the Babylon Spoke and the BTC Vault Swap Spoke: the former lets users borrow stablecoins against BTC locked on the Bitcoin network, while the latter handles liquidations — without wrapping or bridging BTC. The proposal follows a May temperature check that passed on June 10 and must clear community review and a Snapshot vote before any onchain vote.
summary.zh: Babylon Labs于10月14日在Aave治理论坛发布ARFC提案，拟通过其无托管比特币金库 (Trustless Bitcoin Vaults) 将原生BTC (Native Bitcoin) 引入Aave V4作为抵押品。方案设立Babylon Spoke与BTC Vault Swap Spoke两个组件：前者允许用户以锁定在比特币网络上的BTC抵押借入稳定币 (Stablecoin)，后者负责清算结算，全程无需跨链或包装BTC。该提案沿用了6月10日通过的初步社区投票结果，仍需经社区讨论与快照投票 (Snapshot Vote) 后方可进入链上投票。

title.en: Babylon Labs Advances Aave V4 Proposal for Native Bitcoin Collateral via Trustless Vaults
title.zh: Babylon Labs推进Aave V4原生比特币抵押提案，拟通过无托管金库实现借贷

summary.en: Stronger-than-expected US inflation data triggered heavy selling that pushed ether down nearly 6% to about $2,350 on October 15. CryptoQuant analyst Darkfost reported more than $106 million in Binance ETH long liquidations within one hour following the CPI release, the largest hourly liquidation event in six months. RSI sits near 34 as traders watch support around $2,300, while spot ETH ETFs saw provisional outflows.
summary.zh: 9月美国CPI超预期引发抛售，以太币 (Ether) 周四下跌近6%至约2,350美元。CryptoQuant分析师Darkfost称，CPI发布后一小时内，币安ETH多单被清算逾1.06亿美元，为半年来最大单小时爆仓事件。RSI (Relative Strength Index) 接近34，交易员正关注2,300美元附近的支撑位；现货以太币ETF (Spot ETH ETF) 亦录得初步资金流出。

title.en: Ether Drops Nearly 6% to ~$2,350 as $106M in ETH Longs Liquidated in One Hour on Binance
title.zh: 以太币下跌近6%至约2,350美元，币安ETH多单一小时内爆仓逾1.06亿美元

summary.en: Solana fell below $102 on Thursday, extending its October decline to about 13% after a double-top reversal near $122. SoSoValue data showed spot SOL ETFs recorded roughly $1.3 million in net outflows on Wednesday, the eighth consecutive day of withdrawals, following $24.81 million the previous week. Meanwhile, tokenized equity supply on Solana rose to about $611 million across 1.42 million holders. RSI near 35 leaves $100 as the key psychological level, with 200-day EMA support at $97.95.
summary.zh: Solana (SOL) 周四跌破102美元，10月以来累计下跌约13%，月初曾在122美元附近形成双顶反转。SoSoValue数据显示，SOL现货ETF周三净流出约130万美元，为连续第八天净流出，上周累计流出2,481万美元。与此同时，Solana链上股权代币 (Tokenized Equity) 供应量升至约6.11亿美元，分布在142万持有人手中。RSI接近35，100美元成为关键心理关口，下方支撑在200日均线约97.95美元。

title.en: SOL Drops Below $102 as ETF Outflows Extend to Eighth Straight Day; Tokenized Equity Tops $611M
title.zh: SOL跌破102美元，ETF连续第八天净流出；Solana链上股权代币化规模超6.11亿美元

summary.en: Network data suggests Bitcoin's mining difficulty will rise about 5.68% around October 16 at block 971,712, the third-largest increase of 2026. Hashprice would fall from roughly $39.77 to about $37.63 per PH/day, cutting revenue per unit of computing power by about 5.37%. The projection reflects blocks arriving every 9.49 minutes, faster than the protocol's 10-minute target, as hashrate holds near 1 ZH/s — a sign miners keep adding capacity even with BTC under $82,000.
summary.zh: 网络数据显示，比特币挖矿难度 (Mining Difficulty) 将于10月16日区块971,712处上调约5.68%，为2026年第三大涨幅。哈希价格 (Hashprice) 将从约39.77美元降至37.63美元/日/PH，单位算力收入下降约5.37%。此次上调源于出块间隔约为9.49分钟、快于协议10分钟目标，全网算力维持在约1 ZH/s附近——表明即使在BTC低于82,000美元的情况下，矿工仍在持续加码。

title.en: Bitcoin Mining Difficulty Projected to Jump ~5.7% on October 16, Third-Biggest Rise of 2026
title.zh: 比特币挖矿难度预计10月16日上调约5.7%，为2026年第三大涨幅

summary.en: VanEck Digital Assets filed to withdraw its Lido Staked Ethereum ETF registration with the SEC on October 14, ending plans for a fund that would have held Lido's stETH. The firm confirmed the registration never became effective and no shares were issued or sold, without disclosing a reason for the withdrawal. The decision ends this specific proposal but does not establish a new SEC position on liquid staking tokens more broadly.
summary.zh: VanEck Digital Assets于10月14日向SEC (Securities and Exchange Commission) 提交撤回文件，终止其Lido质押以太币ETF (Staked Ether ETF) 的注册计划。该基金原计划持有Lido的stETH；VanEck确认注册从未生效，未发行任何份额，亦未披露撤回原因。此举仅终结该特定产品，并不构成SEC对流动性质押代币 (Liquid Staking Token) 的新立场。

title.en: VanEck Withdraws Lido Staked Ether ETF Registration; No Shares Were Ever Issued
title.zh: VanEck撤回Lido质押以太币ETF注册申请，基金从未发行

summary.en: Tether froze about $10 million in USDT linked to the theft of funds from Ledger devices sold by Malaysian reseller CryptoBilis. Blockchain analytics firm Bitquery raised its estimate of the losses to about $102 million taken from 324 wallets across six blockchains, mostly USDT on TRON. Ledger previously confirmed an unauthorized hardware implant in an affected device that could capture the 24-word recovery phrase during setup, and advised CryptoBilis customers to move assets to new devices with fresh seed phrases.
summary.zh: Tether冻结了约1,000万美元与马来西亚经销商CryptoBilis所售Ledger设备劫案相关的USDT。区块链分析公司Bitquery将损失估计上调至约1.02亿美元，涉324个钱包、横跨六条区块链，大部分为TRON链上的USDT。Ledger此前确认在受影响设备中发现了未经授权的硬件植入物，可在设置过程中窃取24词助记词 (Recovery Phrase)，并建议CryptoBilis客户将资产转移至使用新助记词的新设备。

title.en: Tether Freezes $10M USDT Tied to CryptoBilis Ledger Exploit; On-Chain Estimate Rises to ~$102M
title.zh: Tether冻结与CryptoBilis Ledger劫案相关的1,000万美元USDT；链上损失估计升至约1.02亿美元

summary.en: The SEC on October 13 approved a Cboe rule change to list binary options tied to corporate key performance indicators (KPIs). The approval covers 23 large issuers, including Coinbase's trading volume and transaction revenue, MARA's BTC production and energized hashrate, and Robinhood's funded customers and revenues. The contracts are cash-settled and European-style, paying a fixed $1 or nothing at expiry, with settlement based on figures companies report in their earnings filings.
summary.zh: SEC于10月13日批准了Cboe的规则修改，允许上市与上市公司关键绩效指标 (KPI) 挂钩的二元期权 (Binary Option)。首批覆盖23家大型发行人，包括Coinbase的总交易量与交易收入、MARA (Marathon Digital) 的比特币产量与算力、以及Robinhood的客户数与营收数据。这类合约以现金结算 (Cash-settled)、欧式行权，按公司财报披露的数据结算，固定赔付1美元或零。

title.en: SEC Approves Cboe Binary KPI Options Tied to Coinbase Volume and MARA Bitcoin Output
title.zh: SEC批准Cboe上市挂钩Coinbase交易量、MARA比特币产量的二元KPI期权

summary.en: The US Treasury and FDIC issued proposed rulemakings defining licensing, reserve, and custody requirements for payment stablecoin issuers under the GENIUS Act, with the framework targeted at the law's statutory effective date of January 18, 2027. Separately, the Federal Reserve on October 15 proposed a framework for bank-issued payment stablecoins under the Act, following its earlier state-certification rules. The proposals remain open for public comment.
summary.zh: 美国财政部 (Treasury) 与联邦存款保险公司 (FDIC) 提出了《GENIUS法案》下支付稳定币 (Payment Stablecoin) 的许可、储备与托管规则，发行人需持有联邦或州牌照，规则拟于该法法定生效日2027年1月18日落地。与此同时，美联储于10月15日单独提出了银行发行支付稳定币的框架，延续其此前关于州认证的规则进程。各提案尚处征求意见阶段。

title.en: Treasury and FDIC Advance GENIUS Act Stablecoin Rules Targeting January 18, 2027; Fed Proposes Bank-Issued Framework
title.zh: 美财政部与FDIC推进GENIUS法案稳定币规则制定，拟2027年1月18日生效；美联储单独提议银行发行框架

summary.en: Turkish media reported that Hex and PulseChain founder Richard Heart (legal name Richard James Schueler) was detained in Istanbul's Beşiktaş district on October 14 in a joint police and intelligence (MIT) operation. Authorities reportedly seized about $4 million in cash and 64 luxury watches from his residence. The detention follows a 2024 Interpol Red Notice requested by Finnish authorities over suspected aggravated tax fraud; his wife was also reportedly taken into custody. The SEC's 2023 civil suit against Heart over $1B+ in token offerings was dismissed by a federal judge in February 2025, and regulators declined to amend — this detention is not a new SEC charge.
summary.zh: 土耳其媒体报道，Hex/PulseChain创始人Richard Heart (法定名Richard James Schueler) 于10月14日在伊斯坦布尔贝西克塔斯区被土耳其警方与国家情报组织 (MIT) 联合拘留，警方在其住所查获约400万美元现金与64块名表；其妻子亦一同被拘留。此次拘留基于国际刑警组织 (Interpol) 2024年应芬兰当局要求发出的红色通缉令，涉加重税务欺诈 (Aggravated Tax Fraud) 嫌疑。值得注意的是，SEC 2023年对其逾10亿美元代币发行案的民事诉讼已于2025年2月被联邦法官驳回且未再起诉——本次并非SEC新的指控。

title.en: Hex Founder Richard Heart Detained in Istanbul Under Interpol Red Notice
title.zh: Hex创始人Richard Heart在伊斯坦布尔被拘留，涉国际刑警红色通缉令

summary.en: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded roughly $109.8 million in net inflows on October 13, with Fidelity's Wise Origin Bitcoin Fund accounting for about $103.1 million, reversing the $65.4 million of net outflows seen a day earlier (entirely from BlackRock's IBIT). October remains net negative at around $451 million, signaling fragile institutional demand.
summary.zh: 美国现货比特币ETF (Spot Bitcoin ETF) 在10月13日录得约1.098亿美元净流入，其中富达 (Fidelity) 的Wise Origin Bitcoin Fund贡献约1.031亿美元，扭转了前一日6540万美元净流出的颓势。不过10月以来累计仍净流出约4.51亿美元，机构需求依然脆弱。

title.en: Bitcoin Spot ETFs See ~$109.8M Inflows on Oct 13, Reversing Prior-Day Outflows
title.zh: 比特币现货ETF (Spot ETF) 10月13日净流入约1.1亿美元，扭转前一日流出态势

summary.en: Blockchain security firm Blockaid flagged an ongoing exploit on UNCX Network's shared token vesting pool on Ethereum on October 14, with roughly $86,000 drained in a single transaction. The affected tokens spanned five projects — EDGEN, ZC, pepeCoin, LO0P and PAAL AI — and Blockaid warned the attack was still running.
summary.zh: 区块链安全公司Blockaid于10月14日披露，UNCX Network在以太坊上的共享代币锁仓池 (Shared Vesting Pool) 遭到持续攻击，攻击者通过单笔交易盗走约8.6万美元代币。被盗代币涉及EDGEN、ZC、pepeCoin、LO0P和PAAL AI五个项目，Blockaid警告攻击仍在进行中。

title.en: UNCX Shared Token Vesting Pool Exploited on Ethereum for ~$86,000
title.zh: UNCX共享代币锁仓池 (Vesting Pool) 在以太坊上遭攻击，被盗约8.6万美元

summary.en: Bitcoin treasury company Strive (NASDAQ: ASST) bought 2,822 BTC for about $235 million at an average price of ~$83,266 between October 12 and 13, lifting total holdings to 35,595 BTC and overtaking MARA as the fourth-largest public bitcoin treasury. The firm also raised roughly $369.2 million from warrant exercises and proposed a 15% Series A perpetual preferred stock offering to fund further purchases.
summary.zh: 比特币财库公司Strive (纳斯达克代码ASST) 在10月12日至13日以约83,266美元均价买入2,822枚比特币，总花费约2.35亿美元，持仓增至35,595枚，超越MARA成为第四大上市比特币财库公司。公司同期通过权证行权获得约3.692亿美元资金，并提议发行15%永续优先股SATS继续加仓。

title.en: Strive Buys Another 2,822 BTC for $235M, Lifting Holdings to 35,595 and Passing MARA
title.zh: Strive再斥资2.35亿美元增持2,822枚比特币 (BTC)，持仓升至35,595枚超越MARA

summary.en: U.S. September headline CPI rose 3.7% year over year and core CPI 2.6%, both above consensus, sending bitcoin below $82,000 while ETH, XRP and SOL fell roughly 3%. Money markets repriced the odds of an October Fed rate hike to 49% from 22%, with higher Treasury yields and a firmer dollar weighing on risk assets.
summary.zh: 美国9月整体CPI同比上涨3.7%、核心CPI同比上涨2.6%，均高于市场预期，比特币在数据公布后一度跌破8.2万美元，ETH、XRP、SOL亦下跌约3%。货币市场已将10月美联储加息概率从22%上调至49%，较高收益率与强美元继续压制风险资产。

title.en: Hotter-Than-Expected September US CPI Sends Bitcoin Below $82,000
title.zh: 美国9月CPI (消费者价格指数) 高于预期，比特币跌破8.2万美元

summary.en: Solana core developer Anza announced the Alpenglow consensus upgrade will activate on mainnet-beta at around 14:50 UTC on October 21, replacing TowerBFT — in use since 2020 — with a new voting protocol called Votor, targeting transaction finality of about 150 milliseconds versus roughly 12.8 seconds today. Validators approved the proposal with 98.27% support, and developers describe it as the largest consensus change in Solana's history.
summary.zh: Solana核心开发公司Anza宣布，Alpenglow共识协议升级将于10月21日约14:50 UTC在主网激活，以新的Votor投票机制取代自2020年沿用的TowerBFT，目标将交易最终确认时间 (Finality) 从约12.8秒缩短至150毫秒。该升级已获验证者以98.27%的高票支持，被视为Solana史上最大共识层变革。

title.en: Solana Schedules Alpenglow Upgrade for Oct 21, Targeting ~150ms Finality
title.zh: Solana定于10月21日激活Alpenglow升级，目标交易最终确认 (Finality) 缩至150毫秒

summary.en: On-chain analytics firm Glassnode said bitcoin has twice bounced from around $81,500 — the estimated aggregate cost basis of U.S. spot ETF investors — despite $681 million in net ETF outflows last week and another $65 million on Monday. If the support eventually breaks, Glassnode points to the True Market Mean near $77,500 as the next major level.
summary.zh: 链上分析公司Glassnode指出，比特币已两次在约8.15万美元的美国现货ETF投资者综合成本基准处获得支撑，尽管同期现货ETF上周净流出6.81亿美元、周一再流出6500万美元。Glassnode称，若该支撑最终失守，约7.75万美元的真实市场均值 (True Market Mean) 将是下一个关键位置。

title.en: Glassnode: Bitcoin Twice Defends $81,500 ETF Cost Basis; $77,500 Next if Lost
title.zh: Glassnode：比特币两次守住8.15万美元ETF成本基准，若失守下一关键位在7.75万美元

summary.en: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission made operative a Cboe BZX Exchange rule change on October 13 establishing a standing framework for evaluating options on commodity-based trusts holding multiple crypto assets, waiving the standard 30-day operative delay. Each asset must average at least $700 million in daily market value over the prior 12 months and satisfy surveillance-sharing requirements; the framework authorizes no specific product.
