summary.zh: 美国证监会 (SEC) 于10月13日宣布Cboe BZX交易所关于多加密资产商品信托期权的规则变更即刻生效，豁免了常规的30天等待期。新框架要求信托中每种资产过去12个月日均市值不低于7亿美元，且须满足全面信息共享协议 (Surveillance-Sharing Agreement) 条件。该规则仅建立评估框架，并未批准任何具体产品。

title.en: SEC Makes Cboe BZX Framework Operative for Multi-Crypto Options, Waiving 30-Day Delay
title.zh: SEC批准Cboe BZX多加密资产期权框架即刻生效，不再适用30天延迟

summary.en: Interactive Brokers, reporting over $903 billion in client assets, launched Ethereum staking for eligible clients on October 13, with crypto infrastructure provider Zerohash handling the service. Clients stake through a Staking Dashboard in the Client Portal, with rewards credited as additional staked ETH that can compound; Ethereum is the only supported asset at launch.
summary.zh: 管理超9030亿美元客户资产的盈透证券宣布，合格客户可通过其客户门户的质押看板 (Staking Dashboard) 质押以太坊 (Ethereum)，底层质押服务由Zerohash提供，奖励以额外ETH计入并可复利累积。上线初期仅支持ETH，这是传统券商把加密收益功能嵌入多资产平台的又一步。

title.en: Interactive Brokers Launches Ethereum Staking via Zerohash, ETH Only at Launch
title.zh: 盈透证券 (Interactive Brokers) 上线以太坊质押 (Staking) 服务，初期仅支持ETH

summary.en: The SEC proposed a new crypto custody framework on October 1 for registered investment advisers and regulated funds, permitting qualified custodians, state-chartered trust companies, and conditional direct custody when no qualified custodian can support the asset. Direct custody would require written evidence of unavailability and two-person authorization per transaction, with a 60-day comment period.
summary.zh: 美国证监会 (SEC) 于10月1日提议加密资产托管新框架，允许注册投资顾问和受监管基金使用合格托管人、州特许信托公司，并在特定条件下直接托管 (Direct Custody)。直接托管需提供书面证据证明无可用合格托管人，且每笔交易需至少两人授权。新规征求意见期为60天。

title.en: SEC Proposes New Crypto Custody Framework for Funds and State Trusts
title.zh: SEC提议加密资产托管 (Custody) 新规，允许州特许信托公司托管加密资产

summary.en: Bitcoin hardware wallet maker Coldcard confirmed on October 11 that an unauthorized phishing post appeared on its official X account, falsely claiming a firmware flaw and directing users to a copycat site for a "security migration"; the post has been deleted. The company said it found no login or session records matching the post and has contacted X; no financial losses have been verified.
summary.zh: 比特币硬件钱包厂商Coldcard于10月11日确认，其官方X账号出现一条声称固件存在漏洞、诱导用户前往仿冒网站进行“安全迁移”的钓鱼帖文，公司已删除该帖文。Coldcard表示未发现与该帖文匹配的登录或会话记录，已联系X平台调查；截至目前未核实有资金损失。

title.en: Phishing Link Appears on Coldcard's Official X Account; No Matching Login Records Found
title.zh: Coldcard官方X账号惊现钓鱼链接，公司称未发现匹配登录记录

summary.en: Solana completed its staged SIMD-0525 rollout on October 9, cutting target slot time from 400 milliseconds to 200 milliseconds, with the first full epoch averaging 218.3ms per slot. Blocks are now scheduled twice as often, but per-slot compute limits scaled down proportionally, so total throughput did not double; holders need take no action.
summary.zh: Solana于10月9日完成SIMD-0525提案的分阶段升级，目标出块间隔 (Slot Time) 从400毫秒降至200毫秒，首个完整周期实际平均为218.3毫秒。该升级让区块生产机会翻倍，但每槽计算上限同步减半，总吞吐量并未翻倍；持币者无需操作。

title.en: Solana Completes Staged Reduction of Target Slot Time From 400ms to 200ms
title.zh: Solana完成目标出块间隔 (Slot Time) 从400毫秒降至200毫秒的分阶段升级

summary.en: Thailand's SEC crypto ETF framework takes effect October 16, initially allowing only bitcoin and ether. Funds must maintain average net exposure of at least 80% of NAV per accounting year, use licensed custodians and trade exclusively on the Stock Exchange of Thailand; securities firms are barred from offering margin loans for the purchases.
summary.zh: 泰国证监会 (SEC) 发布的加密ETF框架将于10月16日生效，首期仅允许比特币 (BTC) 和以太坊 (ETH)，基金须保持年均净敞口不低于净资产80%，并使用持牌托管人、在泰国证券交易所 (SET) 交易。证券公司被禁止提供融资买入此类ETF。

title.en: Thailand SEC Crypto ETF Rules Take Effect Oct 16, Limited to Bitcoin and Ether Initially
title.zh: 泰国证监会加密ETF新规10月16日生效，首期仅允许比特币和以太坊

summary.en: Ethereum's next major upgrade, Glamsterdam, activated as scheduled on the Sepolia public testnet on October 6, bundling 18 EIPs headlined by enshrined proposer-builder separation (EIP-7732) and block-level access lists (EIP-7928), with the testnet gas limit trialed near 200 million versus mainnet's 60 million. Next is the Hoodi testnet in late October, with a mainnet target in Q4 2026.
summary.zh: 以太坊下一次重大升级Glamsterdam于10月6日在Sepolia公共测试网按计划激活，包含18项EIP，核心是内嵌的提议者-构建者分离 (ePBS, EIP-7732) 与区块级访问列表 (Block-Level Access Lists, EIP-7928)，目标区块Gas上限测试至约2亿（主网现为6000万）。下一步是10月下旬的Hoodi测试网，主网目标仍为2026年第四季度。

title.en: Ethereum's Glamsterdam Upgrade Activates on Sepolia Testnet With 18 EIPs
title.zh: 以太坊Glamsterdam升级在Sepolia测试网激活，包含18项EIP
比特币在CPI公布前于8.34万美元附近盘整，市场屏息等待9月通胀数据
title.en: Bitcoin Consolidates Near $83,400 Ahead of Today's September CPI Print

summary.zh: 比特币 (Bitcoin) 在10月14日美国9月CPI (消费者价格指数) 公布前进入观望模式，价格在约8.34万至8.38万美元之间横盘。9月16日美联储 (Federal Reserve) 已加息至3.75%-4%区间，若通胀高于预期，可能强化12月再加息的预期并打压风险资产。
summary.en: Bitcoin held a pre-release holding pattern near $83,400-$83,800 ahead of the September US CPI print due at 8:30 a.m. ET on October 14. With the Fed already back in a hiking cycle at 3.75%-4%, a hotter-than-expected print could strengthen expectations of another hike and weigh on risk assets, while a soft print would ease rate fears.

title.zh: Ledger披露CryptoBilis植入细节：通过eSIM和蜂窝网络窃取24词助记词
title.en: Ledger Details LTE Implants That Copied 24-Word Recovery Phrases via Cellular Networks

summary.zh: Ledger安全团队 (Ledger Donjon) 披露，CryptoBilis渠道售出的设备中的恶意植入体会在设置时截取屏幕显示的24词助记词 (recovery phrase)，通过内置eSIM (嵌入式SIM卡) 经由LTE网络传出。公司强调植入体未破坏安全芯片，也未篡改交易，并正在核查CryptoBilis之外的报告。
summary.en: Ledger's security team (Ledger Donjon) disclosed that malicious implants in devices sold via CryptoBilis captured the 24-word recovery phrase shown during setup and transmitted it over LTE networks using an embedded eSIM. The company stressed the implant did not compromise the secure chip or alter transactions, and said it is examining reports beyond the CryptoBilis reseller.

title.zh: ENS创始人向DAO提交ENSv2主网激活提案，新.eth注册将暂停数小时
title.en: ENS Founder Submits ENSv2 Mainnet Activation Proposal to DAO; New .eth Registrations Would Pause

summary.zh: 以太坊域名服务 (Ethereum Name Service, ENS) 创始人Nick Johnson向ENS DAO提交可执行提案，请求激活ENSv2命名系统主网。提案要求冻结旧注册器的新注册，现有域名持有人可继续续费无需迁移；通过需要100万票的多数支持及7天链上投票 (onchain vote)。
summary.en: Ethereum Name Service (ENS) founder Nick Johnson submitted an executable draft proposal to the ENS DAO seeking to activate the ENSv2 naming system on mainnet. The proposal would freeze new registrations on the original registrar while existing holders keep their names without migrating; passage requires a majority of at least 1 million ENS votes over a seven-day onchain vote.

title.zh: Autheo的THEO代币疑遭跨链桥攻击，24小时暴跌92%
title.en: Autheo's THEO Token Plunges 92% After Suspected Cross-Chain Bridge Exploit

summary.zh: Autheo团队证实正调查一起涉及THEO代币的安全事件，并警告持币者在调查结束前不要买卖或跨链桥接 (bridge) THEO。区块链安全公司PeckShield报告攻击者在Base链上未经授权铸造约1900万THEO并兑换为约700.8 ETH (约176万美元)；另一位研究者称铸造量可能高达1.19亿枚。
summary.en: The Autheo team confirmed it is investigating a security incident involving the THEO token and warned holders not to buy, sell, or bridge THEO until its investigation concludes. Blockchain security firm PeckShield reported the attacker minted about 19 million THEO on Base without authorization and swapped them for roughly 700.8 ETH (about $1.76 million); another researcher claimed unauthorized minting could be as high as 119 million tokens.

title.zh: Pando Finance香港第二只SOL现货ETF今日上市，管理费0.6%
title.en: Pando Finance Lists Hong Kong's Second Spot Solana ETF Today With 0.6% Management Fee

summary.zh: Pando Finance的SOL现货ETF (代码02831) 今日在香港交易所 (Hong Kong Stock Exchange) 上市，成为继华夏 (ChinaAMC) 之后香港第二只直接持有SOL的产品。基金年管理费0.6%、预计经常性开支1.6%，通过HashKey交易与托管，且不进行质押 (staking)、不使用衍生品。
summary.en: Pando Finance's spot Solana ETF (ticker 02831) listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange today, becoming Hong Kong's second fund directly holding SOL after ChinaAMC's product. The fund charges a 0.6% annual management fee with an estimated 1.6% ongoing expense ratio, uses HashKey Exchange for trading and HashKey Custody for safekeeping, and will not stake its SOL or use derivatives.

title.zh: Strategy上周再增持250枚比特币，总持仓达84.8万枚
title.en: Strategy Adds Another 250 Bitcoin, Holdings Reach 848,250 BTC

summary.zh: Strategy (前MicroStrategy) 在10月5日至11日期间以约2150万美元购入250枚比特币 (Bitcoin)，均价约8.62万美元，总持仓达到84.825万枚。公司同日财报显示同期回购了约1.92亿美元优先股 (preferred shares)，投入回购的资金约为购币资金的九倍。
summary.en: Strategy bought 250 BTC between October 5 and 11 for about $21.5 million at an average price of roughly $86,194, bringing total holdings to 848,250 BTC. The same filing showed about $192.4 million of preferred-share repurchases in the same window — roughly nine times what the company spent on Bitcoin.

title.zh: 周一美现货比特币ETF净流出6540万美元，10月累计流出4.52亿美元
title.en: US Spot Bitcoin ETFs Lose $65.4M on Monday; October Now at a $452M Deficit

summary.zh: 10月12日美国现货比特币 (Spot Bitcoin) ETF单日净流出6540万美元，全部来自贝莱德 (BlackRock) 的IBIT，其余11只产品无资金变动。以太坊 (Ether) ETF同日净流出8540万美元；10月至今美比特币ETF累计净流出约4.52亿美元，抹去了月初连续四个交易日的流入。
summary.en: US spot Bitcoin ETFs posted $65.4 million in net outflows on Monday, October 12 — all of it from BlackRock's IBIT, with the other 11 funds reporting no flow — while spot Ether ETFs shed $85.4 million. October's net Bitcoin ETF flow now stands at about negative $452 million, wiping out the inflows from the month's first four sessions.

title.zh: 法国财委会支持稳定币兑换税与加密离境税，随后否决预算案
title.en: French Finance Committee Backs Stablecoin Swap Tax and Crypto Exit Tax, Then Rejects the Budget

summary.zh: 法国国民议会财政委员会通过两项加密税修正案：自2027年1月1日起将加密货币兑换为MiCA定义的稳定币视为应税出售，并将离境税 (exit tax) 扩展至加密资产（持仓超80万欧元且移居国外者）。但委员会随后否决了2027年预算的收入部分，两项措施须在10月13日开始的全会辩论中重新提出。
summary.en: France's National Assembly finance committee adopted two crypto tax amendments: treating crypto-to-stablecoin swaps (MiCA-defined electronic money tokens) as taxable sales from January 1, 2027, and extending the exit tax to crypto holdings above €800,000 for those moving tax residence abroad. The committee then rejected the revenue section of the 2027 budget, so both measures must be reintroduced when the full chamber debates the budget from October 13.

title.zh: "加密妈妈"Hester Peirce卸任SEC委员，委员会仅剩两名委员
title.en: 'Crypto Mom' Hester Peirce Leaves SEC; Commission Down to Two Sitting Members

summary.zh: 被称为"加密妈妈"的SEC (美国证券交易委员会) 委员Hester Peirce于10月2日正式卸任，结束其近九年任期；她曾领导SEC加密工作组 (Crypto Task Force)。她的离开使委员会仅剩主席Paul Atkins和委员Mark Uyeda两名在任委员，三个席位空缺待总统提名与参议院确认。
summary.en: SEC Commissioner Hester Peirce, nicknamed 'Crypto Mom,' officially stepped down on October 2, ending a nearly nine-year tenure that included leading the SEC's Crypto Task Force. Her departure leaves the commission with only two sitting members — Chairman Paul Atkins and Commissioner Mark Uyeda — with three seats vacant pending presidential nomination and Senate confirmation.

title.zh: Ledger经销商供应链攻击：约9300万美元被盗，确认硬件植入，Tether冻结1000万美元
title.en: Ledger Reseller Supply-Chain Attack: ~$93M Stolen, Hardware Implant Confirmed, Tether Freezes $10M

summary.zh: 法国硬件钱包厂商Ledger确认，从马来西亚经销商CryptoBilis购入的设备中发现未授权硬件植入（hardware implant）。区块链分析公司Bitquery追踪到约9300万美元加密资产从315个钱包被盗（另有估计称9400万至9450万美元），Tether已冻结其中约1000万美元USDT (Tether)。
summary.en: Ledger confirmed an unauthorized hardware implant in devices bought from Malaysian reseller CryptoBilis. Blockchain analytics firm Bitquery traced about $93.2 million stolen from 315 wallets (other estimates put losses at $94-94.5 million), and Tether has frozen $10 million in USDT linked to the theft.

title.zh: 比特币与以太坊现货ETF单周合计净流出12.2亿美元，比特币结束三周流入
title.en: Spot Bitcoin and Ether ETFs Record Combined $1.2B Weekly Outflows; Bitcoin Ends Three-Week Inflow Streak

summary.zh: 10月5日至9日，美国现货比特币 (Spot Bitcoin) ETF净流出6.81亿美元，以太坊 (Ethereum) ETF净流出5.42亿美元，合计约12.2亿美元。其中贝莱德 (BlackRock) 的ETHA占以太坊ETF流出的4.77亿美元，两只产品均告别此前的连续净流入。
summary.en: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs saw $681 million in net outflows and spot Ether ETFs $542 million during October 5-9, a combined $1.2 billion. BlackRock's ETHA accounted for $477 million of the Ether withdrawals, ending weeks of consecutive inflows for both products.

title.zh: 比特币重返84,000美元上方，做空平仓助推反弹；小市值代币领涨
title.en: Bitcoin Back Above $84,000 on Short Covering; Small-Cap Tokens Lead the Rally

summary.zh: 比特币 (Bitcoin) 周一回升至84,000美元上方，24小时涨约1.3%，反弹主要来自空头平仓和期货做多力量回补。此轮涨幅由流动性较薄的小市值代币引领（CoinDesk 80指数涨约3%），以太坊回升至2,560美元附近，市场静待周三美国9月CPI数据。
summary.en: Bitcoin climbed back above $84,000 on Monday, up about 1.3% in 24 hours as heavy short liquidations forced bearish traders to cover. Gains were led by thinly traded small-cap tokens (the CoinDesk 80 index rose ~3%), while Ether recovered toward $2,560 ahead of Wednesday's U.S. September CPI release.

title.zh: Solana现货ETF单周净流出2480万美元，终结连续14周流入
title.en: Solana Spot ETFs Post $24.8M Weekly Outflows, Ending 14-Week Inflow Streak

summary.zh: 美国Solana现货ETF在10月5日至9日当周净流出2480万美元，连续五日出现赎回，终结了长达14周的净流入纪录。产品总资产从19亿美元降至约17.3亿美元，Solana在代币化股票交易量中仍占约65%份额。
summary.en: U.S. spot Solana ETFs recorded $24.8 million in net outflows during October 5-9, five straight days of withdrawals that ended a 14-week inflow streak. Total net assets fell from $1.90 billion to about $1.73 billion, while Solana retained roughly a 65% share of tokenized-equities trading volume.

title.zh: 美SEC提议加密托管新规：允许有条件自托管，州信托公司可作合格托管人
title.en: SEC Proposes Crypto Custody Rules: Conditional Self-Custody, State Trust Companies as Qualified Custodians

summary.zh: 美国证监会 (SEC) 于10月1日提议的数字资产托管框架允许注册投资顾问在特定条件下自持客户加密资产的私钥，并将州特许信托公司纳入合格托管人 (qualified custodian) 名单。该提案已于10月6日发布于《联邦公报》(Federal Register)，公众意见征询期至12月7日。
summary.en: The SEC's October 1 custody proposal would let registered investment advisers hold client crypto private keys themselves under limited conditions and add state-chartered trust companies to the list of qualified custodians. Published in the Federal Register on October 6, the proposal is open for public comment through December 7.

title.zh: Coldcard官方X账号惊现钓鱼链接，公司称未发现异常登录记录
title.en: Coldcard's Official X Account Publishes Phishing Link; No Unauthorized Login Found

summary.zh: 比特币硬件钱包厂商Coldcard (Coinkite) 表示，其官方X账号10月11日出现一条冒充固件漏洞警告的钓鱼帖，诱导用户前往仿冒网站进行“安全迁移”，帖子已被删除。公司称账户启用离线双因素认证 (2FA)，内部审查未发现异常登录，已要求X平台协助调查；暂未确认用户资金损失。
summary.en: Bitcoin hardware wallet maker Coldcard said a phishing post appeared on its official X account on October 11, posing as an urgent firmware flaw warning and directing users to a copycat site for a "security migration"; the post has been deleted. The firm found no unauthorized login records, credits offline 2FA, and has asked X to investigate; no verified user losses so far.

title.zh: Solana完成200毫秒出块间隔升级，较8月翻倍出块频率
title.en: Solana Completes 200-Millisecond Slot Upgrade, Doubling Block Frequency Since August

summary.zh: Solana于10月9日在主网epoch 1053激活200毫秒目标出块间隔 (slot time)，较原先的400毫秒减半，完成了自8月21日以来的四阶段降速（400→350→300→250→200毫秒）。该升级为网络层面变更（SIMD-0525），并非Alpenglow共识升级；区块更小更频繁，网络每秒理论处理能力大致不变。
summary.en: Solana activated a 200-millisecond target slot time on mainnet at epoch 1053 on October 9, halving its original 400ms setting and completing a four-stage reduction since August 21 (400→350→300→250→200ms). The network-level change (SIMD-0525) is distinct from the Alpenglow consensus upgrade; blocks are smaller but more frequent, leaving theoretical per-second capacity roughly unchanged.

title.zh: 美SEC批准首批3倍杠杆比特币与以太坊ETF上市规则，仍需注册生效后才能交易
title.en: SEC Approves First 3x Bitcoin and Ether ETF Listing Rule; Trading Still Needs Effective Registration

summary.zh: 美SEC于10月2日批准Cboe BZX交易所规则变更，允许Volatility Shares旗下六只3倍杠杆产品上市，含3倍比特币ETF与3倍以太坊ETF，是美国历史上首次突破2倍杠杆上限的加密杠杆产品。该批准仅是上市规则许可，产品仍需注册声明生效后方可交易；六只产品均将通过受监管的期货合约 (futures) 实现杠杆，而非直接持有现货。
summary.en: The SEC on October 2 approved a Cboe BZX rule change allowing six 3x leveraged products from Volatility Shares to list, including 3x Bitcoin and 3x Ether ETFs — the first U.S. crypto products to break the 2x leverage ceiling. The order only permits listing; trading still requires an effective registration statement. All six will use regulated futures, not spot holdings, for leverage.

title.zh: 泰国SEC批准本土比特币与以太坊ETF，10月16日生效
title.en: Thailand's SEC Approves Locally Listed Bitcoin and Ether ETFs, Effective October 16

summary.zh: 泰国证监会 (SEC) 于10月8日发布11份通知，允许本土资管公司在泰国证券交易所 (SET) 发行比特币与以太坊ETF，10月16日起生效。规则要求基金每个会计年度对单一加密资产的平均净敞口不低于资产净值 (NAV) 的80%，资产须交由泰国SEC监管的本土托管人保管；散户暂不能通过存托凭证 (DR) 等间接购买海外加密ETF。
summary.en: Thailand's SEC on October 8 issued 11 notifications allowing local asset managers to launch Bitcoin and Ether ETFs on the Stock Exchange of Thailand, effective October 16. Funds must keep average net exposure to a single crypto asset at no less than 80% of NAV each accounting year and use SEC-regulated local custodians; retail investors remain barred from indirect access to foreign crypto ETFs via instruments like depositary receipts.

title.zh: 以太坊Glamsterdam升级在Sepolia测试网激活，主网时间待定
title.en: Ethereum's Glamsterdam Upgrade Activates on Sepolia Testnet; Mainnet Date Undecided

summary.zh: 以太坊Glamsterdam升级于10月6日在Sepolia测试网 (Sepolia testnet) 按期激活，这是主网上线前的关键一步。升级核心包括协议内生的提议者-构建者分离 (enshrined proposer-builder separation, ePBS) 与区块级访问列表 (block-level access lists, BALs)，目标是大幅提升一层 (L1) 吞吐量；以太坊基金会称主网日期尚未确定。
summary.en: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade activated on the Sepolia testnet on October 6 as scheduled, a key step before mainnet. Headline changes include enshrined proposer-builder separation (ePBS) and block-level access lists (BALs), targeting much higher Layer 1 throughput; the Ethereum Foundation says the mainnet date is not yet decided.

title.zh: Solana生态10月迎来多起大额代币解锁，DoubleZero领衔释放约1.13亿美元
title.en: Solana Ecosystem Faces Large October Token Unlocks; DoubleZero Leads With ~$113M

summary.zh: 10月Solana生态多个项目释放大批锁定代币：DoubleZero (2Z) 10月2日起解锁17.8亿枚（约1.13亿美元），占流通量约34.8%，其12个月归属悬崖到期；Official Trump (TRUMP) 解锁约2802万枚（约6080万美元）；Pump.fun (PUMP) 按月线性释放70亿枚（约4025万美元）；deBridge (DBR) 将于10月17日解锁约6.18亿枚。反观Sanctum (SANC) 10月6日通过治理投票销毁25%供应。
summary.en: Several Solana projects unlock large token batches in October: DoubleZero ($2Z) begins unlocking 1.78 billion tokens (~$113M) on October 2, about 34.8% of circulating supply, as its 12-month vesting cliff expires; Official Trump ($TRUMP) releases ~28.02M tokens (~$60.8M); Pump.fun ($PUMP) linearly vests 7B tokens (~$40.25M); deBridge ($DBR) unlocks ~618.33M on October 17. In the opposite direction, Sanctum ($SANC) burned 25% of its supply on October 6 after a governance vote.

title.zh: EIP-8363从以太坊Hegotá升级中撤回，发行政策辩论移交独立流程
title.en: EIP-8363 Withdrawn From Ethereum's Hegotá Upgrade; Issuance Debate Moves to Separate Process

summary.zh: 拟按质押比例销毁验证者奖励的EIP-8363（Tapered Issuance Burn）提案作者于10月1日宣布，从以太坊下下代升级Hegotá的备选中撤回该提案，称分叉选型流程不适合裁决发行政策这类根本性变革。作者将转入专门的多节点治理流程，首场发行政策论坛定于11月Devcon举行。
summary.en: The authors of EIP-8363 (Tapered Issuance Burn), which would burn a rising share of validator rewards as staking grows, withdrew the proposal from consideration for Ethereum's Hegotá upgrade on October 1, saying a fork-scoping process is not the right venue for issuance policy. They will pursue a dedicated governance process, starting with an issuance forum at Devcon in November.

title.zh: 加密市场迎关键一周：比特币守83,000美元、以太坊约2,500美元，周三CPI成焦点
title.en: Crypto Enters a Key Week: Bitcoin Near $83,000, Ether Near $2,500, Wednesday CPI in Focus

summary.zh: 加密市场以比特币 (Bitcoin) 约83,000美元、以太坊 (Ethereum) 约2,500美元开启10月12日至18日的一周。美国9月消费者价格指数 (CPI) 定于周三10月14日公布，市场预期总体通胀率约3.7%；同周还有Aptos与Arbitrum代币解锁 (token unlock) 以及周五约12.5亿美元的期权到期 (options expiry)。
summary.en: Crypto markets enter the week of October 12-18 with Bitcoin near $83,000 and Ethereum near $2,500. U.S. September CPI data arrives Wednesday, October 14, with headline inflation expected near 3.7%; the calendar also includes Aptos and Arbitrum token unlocks and a Friday options expiry of about $1.25 billion.

title.zh: 比特币现货ETF录得6月底以来最差一周：净流出约6.81亿美元
title.en: Spot Bitcoin ETFs Post Worst Week Since Late June With About $681M in Net Outflows

summary.zh: 美国现货比特币ETF (Spot Bitcoin ETF) 在截至10月9日的一周净流出约6.81亿美元，为6月底以来最差单周表现，周五单日转为净流入2,110万美元，其中贝莱德IBIT贡献约2,240万美元。多家报道指出，机构需求 (institutional demand) 明显降温，比特币周末在81,300至85,200美元的窄幅区间内交投。
summary.en: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded about $681 million in net outflows in the week to October 9, their worst week since late June, before returning to a $21.1 million inflow on Friday, with BlackRock's IBIT accounting for about $22.4 million. Reports point to cooled institutional demand, while Bitcoin traded over the weekend inside a narrow $81,300-$85,200 range.

title.zh: Solana完成出块时间减半：200毫秒槽位在主网epoch 1053生效
title.en: Solana Completes Block-Time Halving: 200-Millisecond Slots Live at Epoch 1053

summary.zh: Solana已完成SIMD-0525分阶段升级，目标槽位时间 (slot time) 从最初的400毫秒降至200毫秒，最终一步于10月9日在epoch 1053生效，每秒可提供5次出块机会。每个区块的计算上限 (compute units) 同步降至3,000万单位，因此网络总处理能力大致不变；验证者投票与网络压力则相应上升。
summary.en: Solana has completed its staged SIMD-0525 upgrade, cutting target slot time from the original 400 milliseconds to 200 milliseconds, with the final step taking effect at epoch 1053 on October 9 and allowing five block-production opportunities per second. Each block's compute limit falls to 30 million compute units, keeping overall processing capacity roughly unchanged while validator voting demands rise.

title.zh: 本周代币解锁日历：Aptos释放1,131万枚APT，Arbitrum将于10月16日解锁
title.en: This Week's Token Unlock Calendar: Aptos Releases 11.31M APT, Arbitrum Unlock Due October 16

summary.zh: Aptos于10月11日释放1,131万枚APT (token unlock)，估值约906万美元，分配给核心贡献者、社区、投资者与基金会。Arbitrum定于10月16日解锁约9,270万枚ARB，估值约1,990万美元；供应释放与周五的期权到期叠加，成为本周需要关注的流动性 (liquidity) 事件。
summary.en: Aptos released 11.31 million APT on October 11, valued at about $9.06 million, allocated to core contributors, the community, investors and the foundation. Arbitrum is scheduled to unlock about 92.7 million ARB on October 16, valued at roughly $19.9 million; together with Friday's options expiry, the supply events are key liquidity items on this week's calendar.

title.zh: 以太坊Glamsterdam升级在Sepolia运行，区块gas上限测试近2亿
title.en: Ethereum's Glamsterdam Upgrade Runs on Sepolia, Testing a Near-200M Gas Limit

summary.zh: 以太坊下一次硬分叉Glamsterdam已于10月6日在Sepolia测试网 (testnet) 激活，引入协议内提议者-构建者分离 (ePBS, EIP-7732) 与区块级访问列表 (block-level access lists, EIP-7928)，以支持并行处理。Sepolia区块的gas上限 (gas limit) 已升至近2亿，约为此前6,000万的三倍多；Hoodi测试网与主网日期尚未确定。
summary.en: Ethereum's next hard fork, Glamsterdam, activated on the Sepolia testnet on October 6, introducing enshrined proposer-builder separation (ePBS, EIP-7732) and block-level access lists (EIP-7928) to support parallel processing. Sepolia blocks are running with a gas limit near 200 million, more than three times the previous roughly 60 million; dates for the Hoodi testnet and mainnet remain undecided.

title.zh: Coldcard官方X账号被盗用发布钓鱼帖，假称Mk4、Mk5与Q存在固件漏洞
title.en: Coldcard's Official X Account Used for Phishing Post Falsely Claiming Firmware Flaw in Mk4, Mk5 and Q

summary.zh: 比特币硬件钱包厂商Coldcard的官方X账号于10月11日约02:00 UTC发布一条钓鱼帖 (phishing)，假称Mk4、Mk5与Q设备存在严重固件漏洞，诱导用户通过虚假迁移页面转移资产，该帖随后被删除。公司表示其内部审查未发现异常登录记录，已联系X展开调查，并提醒用户其唯一官网为coldcard.com；目前尚无经证实的用户损失报告。
summary.en: A phishing post appeared on Bitcoin hardware-wallet maker Coldcard's official X account around 02:00 UTC on October 11, falsely claiming a critical firmware vulnerability in the Mk4, Mk5 and Q devices and urging users to move funds through a fake migration page; the post was later deleted. The company said an internal review found no matching login records, that it has contacted X for an investigation, and that coldcard.com is its only official website; no verified user losses have been reported.

title.zh: Ledger确认一台受影响设备含未授权硬件植入，CryptoBilis停售全部硬件钱包
title.en: Ledger Confirms Unauthorized Hardware Implant in One Affected Device; CryptoBilis Halts All Hardware Wallet Sales

summary.zh: Ledger于10月10日确认，在CryptoBilis调查中，一名受影响用户的设备内发现未授权硬件植入 (hardware implant)，这是公司首次证实物理篡改 (physical tampering)。链上分析公司Bitquery估计311个钱包损失约9,290万美元，调查者Specter的估计超过8,600万美元，但Ledger尚未证实任何数字；CryptoBilis已停售全部硬件钱包。
summary.en: Ledger confirmed on October 10 that a device belonging to one affected user in the CryptoBilis investigation contained an unauthorized hardware implant, its first confirmation of physical tampering. Blockchain analytics firm Bitquery estimated about $92.9 million lost across 311 wallets and investigator Specter put losses above $86 million, but Ledger has not verified any figure; CryptoBilis has halted sales of all hardware wallets.

title.zh: 现货以太坊ETF连续第九日净流出：10月9日流出5,610万美元，全部来自贝莱德ETHA
title.en: Spot Ether ETFs See Ninth Straight Outflow Day: $56.1M Leaves on October 9, All From BlackRock's ETHA

summary.zh: 美国现货以太坊ETF (Spot Ether ETF) 于10月9日净流出5,610万美元，连续第九个交易日流出，且当日流出全部来自贝莱德的ETHA。自9月29日以来累计流出约6.97亿美元，基金总资产降至约157.1亿美元；ETH同期交投于2,496美元附近。
summary.en: U.S. spot Ether ETFs posted $56.1 million in net outflows on October 9, a ninth straight day of withdrawals, with the entire amount coming from BlackRock's ETHA. Cumulative outflows since September 29 total about $697 million and total fund assets have fallen to roughly $15.71 billion, while ETH traded near $2,496.

title.zh: Santiment：Solana网络增长自9月初以来跃升124%，日增约171万个新钱包
title.en: Santiment: Solana Network Growth Up 124% Since Early September, About 1.71M New Wallets a Day

summary.zh: 链上分析公司Santiment数据显示，Solana网络增长 (network growth) 自9月初以来跃升124%，每日新建钱包约171万个；日活跃地址 (daily active addresses) 同期上升58%，达到约427万个。网络上持有稳定币的地址数也在10月7日突破1,400万；分析同时提醒，地址增长不等同于真实新增用户。
summary.en: On-chain analytics firm Santiment reports Solana network growth has jumped 124% since early September, with about 1.71 million new wallets created daily. Daily active addresses rose 58% over the same period to roughly 4.27 million, and addresses holding stablecoins on the network passed 14 million on October 7; analysts caution that address growth does not equal the same number of new human users.

title.zh: OKX获Circle、Ripple等战略投资，OKXICE代币化美股场所成SEC豁免框架早期测试
title.en: OKX Draws Strategic Investment From Circle and Ripple as OKXICE Tokenized-Stock Venue Tests SEC Exemption

summary.zh: OKX披露获得Circle、Ripple、QRT与渣打银行旗下SC Ventures的战略投资 (strategic investment)，此前ICE已入股。其与ICE的合资企业OKXICE计划在SEC创新豁免 (Innovation Exemption) 下推出代币化美股 (tokenized stocks) 场所，覆盖63家美国公司、在X Layer上以USDC、USDT、USDG结算，代币保留分红与投票权；分析师认为机构采用程度仍待观察。
summary.en: OKX disclosed strategic investments from Circle, Ripple, QRT and Standard Chartered's SC Ventures, following an earlier investment by ICE. Its OKXICE joint venture with ICE plans a tokenized-stock venue under the SEC Innovation Exemption covering 63 U.S. companies, settling in USDC, USDT and USDG on X Layer with tokens retaining dividend and voting rights; analysts say the scale of institutional adoption remains to be seen.

title.zh: 贝森特：美国本周可能再扣押约10亿美元与伊朗关联的加密货币
title.en: Bessent: U.S. May Seize Another $1B in Iran-Linked Crypto This Week

summary.zh: 美国财政部长Scott Bessent在华盛顿Newsmax政策峰会上表示，美国本周可能再扣押约10亿美元与伊朗关联的加密货币，并称当局已掌握资金位置，正推进所谓绝对孤立 (absolute isolation) 行动。他未说明涉及的具体资产或钱包；此前Tether已在2026年配合制裁执法冻结约5.5亿美元USDT。
summary.en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told the Newsmax Policy Summit in Washington that the United States may seize about another $1 billion in Iran-linked cryptocurrency this week, saying authorities know where the funds are as part of an 'absolute isolation' campaign. He did not specify the assets or wallets involved; Tether has previously frozen about $550 million in USDT during 2026 as part of sanctions enforcement.

title.zh: FinCEN撤回两项加密拟议规则：自托管钱包报告与混币特别措施均终止
title.en: FinCEN Withdraws Two Proposed Crypto Rules: Unhosted-Wallet Reporting and Mixer Special Measure

summary.zh: 美国金融犯罪执法局 (FinCEN) 于10月5日宣布、10月6日在《联邦公报》刊登，正式撤回两项拟议规则：2020年的非托管钱包 (unhosted wallet) 交易报告要求，以及2023年将国际加密混币 (CVC mixing) 列为主要洗钱关切的特别措施。FinCEN援引公众意见称，两项提案可能对合法活动产生寒蝉效应 (chilling effect) 并带来沉重报告负担；现有《银行保密法》义务不变。
summary.en: The U.S. Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) announced on October 5, with Federal Register publication on October 6, the withdrawal of two proposed rules: the 2020 unhosted-wallet transaction reporting requirements and the 2023 special measure treating international CVC mixing as a primary money-laundering concern. FinCEN cited public comments that the proposals could chill legitimate activity and impose heavy reporting burdens; existing Bank Secrecy Act obligations remain unchanged.

Bitcoin held steady near $83,000 over the weekend after rebounding more than 2% on Friday from Thursday's lows around $80,000. CoinDesk reported BTC climbing back above $83,000, while CoinPulseHQ's daily market roundup showed Worldcoin as the day's top mover with an 11% jump. Sentiment remains tied to Treasury yields and oil prices.
summary.zh: 比特币在周末持稳于83,000美元附近，此前周五反弹逾2%，从周四80,000美元左右的低点回升。CoinDesk报道称比特币已重新站上83,000美元上方，而CoinPulseHQ的市场日报显示当日涨幅居前的是Worldcoin，大涨约11%。市场情绪仍受美债收益率与油价走势牵动。

title.en: Bitcoin Steady Near $83,000 Over the Weekend as Worldcoin Jumps 11%
title.zh: 比特币周末持稳于83,000美元附近，Worldcoin领涨11%

summary.en: Token Terminal data published by Solana Hub on October 10 shows Solana's on-chain applications earned $38.2 million in seven days, more than three times Ethereum's $11.7 million, topping the ranking with Hyperliquid second at $14.8 million. Low fees and high throughput keep drawing trading apps to Solana at scale.
summary.zh: Token Terminal数据显示，Solana链上应用 (dApp) 过去7天收入达3,820万美元，约为以太坊（1,170万美元）的三倍以上，在Solana Hub于10月10日发布的榜单中居首，Hyperliquid以1,480万美元居第二。低手续费与高吞吐持续吸引交易类应用在Solana上大规模部署。

title.en: Solana dApp Revenue Hits $38.2M in Seven Days, More Than 3x Ethereum
title.zh: Solana应用收入7天达3,820万美元，为以太坊三倍多

summary.en: THORChain technical co-founder Chad Barraford said Tether blacklisted four of the protocol's Tron vault addresses on October 9 without prior notice, freezing about 1.45 million USDT and halting Tron swaps and liquidity-provider operations for roughly three hours before reversing the action. The incident renewed debate over centralized stablecoin issuers' control of DeFi assets.
summary.zh: THORChain技术联合创始人Chad Barraford称，Tether于10月9日在无事先沟通的情况下，将THORChain四个TRON金库地址列入黑名单 (blacklist)，冻结约145万枚USDT，导致该链跨链兑换与流动性提供功能中断约三小时，随后全部解封。此事再次引发关于中心化稳定币发行方对DeFi协议资产控制权的讨论。

title.en: Tether Briefly Freezes About $1.45M USDT in THORChain Tron Vaults, Then Reverses
title.zh: Tether临时冻结THORChain四个TRON金库约145万美元USDT，三小时后解封

summary.en: Thailand's Securities and Exchange Commission finalized 11 notifications allowing local asset managers to launch Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs on the Stock Exchange of Thailand, effective October 16. Initially only BTC and ETH are eligible; each ETF must hold at least 80% of net asset value in a single cryptocurrency with SEC-regulated custodians, while Thai retail investors will be barred from foreign crypto ETFs.
summary.zh: 泰国证券交易委员会 (SEC) 批准了11项新规，允许本地资产管理公司在泰国证券交易所 (SET) 发行比特币与以太坊ETF，规则自10月16日起生效。初期仅比特币和以太坊可作为底层资产，每只ETF须将至少80%的净资产配置于单一加密货币，并由受SEC监管的托管机构保管；泰国散户将不得购买海外加密ETF。

title.en: Thailand Approves Local Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs, Framework Effective October 16
title.zh: 泰国批准本土比特币与以太坊ETF，规则10月16日生效

summary.en: The U.S. Department of Justice announced that Empire Market co-creator Raheim Hamilton was sentenced to 40 years in federal prison and fined $5 million; as part of his plea, he agreed to forfeit about 1,230 Bitcoin (worth roughly $101 million) and 24.4 Ether. The dark-web market processed over 4 million transactions worth more than $430 million between 2018 and 2020, including nearly $375 million in drug sales.
summary.zh: 美国司法部宣布，暗网市场Empire Market的联合创建者Raheim Hamilton被判处40年联邦监禁并罚款500万美元；作为认罪协议的一部分，他同意没收约1,230枚比特币（价值约1.01亿美元）及24.4枚以太坊。该市场2018年至2020年间促成超过400万笔交易，总额逾4.3亿美元，其中毒品销售额近3.75亿美元。

title.en: Empire Market Co-Founder Sentenced to 40 Years, Forfeits 1,230 Bitcoin
title.zh: 暗网市场Empire Market联合创始人被判40年监禁，没收1,230枚比特币

summary.en: The European Securities and Markets Authority published a call for evidence asking banks, clearinghouses and custodians to show that central counterparties can access, transfer and quickly liquidate tokenized collateral under stress, including a clearing-member default. Responses are due January 15, 2027, and ESMA will assess in Q1 2027 whether further regulatory action is needed.
summary.zh: 欧洲证券与市场管理局 (ESMA) 发布征求证据文件 (call for evidence)，要求银行、清算所和托管机构证明：在清算会员违约等压力情景下，中央对手方 (CCP) 能否获取、转移代币化抵押品并迅速将其变现。反馈截止2027年1月15日，ESMA将于2027年第一季度评估是否需要进一步监管行动。

title.en: ESMA Opens Call for Evidence on Tokenized Collateral, Testing Crisis Liquidity
title.zh: ESMA就代币化抵押品公开征求证据，评估危机中的可变现性

summary.en: El Salvador added 7 BTC over the past week, lifting its national Bitcoin reserve to 7,798 coins worth more than $643 million. Notably, the IMF just approved a $138 million disbursement and granted a waiver for the country's earlier breach of Bitcoin-accumulation limits; the Fund determined additions since June 2025 came from private donations rather than public funds.
summary.zh: 萨尔瓦多政府继续增持比特币，过去7天新增7枚，国家比特币储备达到7,798枚，价值逾6.43亿美元。值得注意的是，IMF刚刚批准向萨尔瓦多拨付1.38亿美元贷款，并就此前政府增持比特币违反贷款条款给予豁免 (waiver)；IMF认定2025年6月之后的新增部分来自私人捐赠而非公共资金。

title.en: El Salvador Adds 7 BTC, National Reserve Hits 7,798 Coins
title.zh: 萨尔瓦多一周增持7枚比特币，国家储备达7,798枚

summary.en: Moscow Exchange senior managing director Boris Blokhin confirmed the bourse plans to launch crypto trading on December 1 under Russia's new digital-asset legislation, with testing underway alongside professional traders. The initial lineup is Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, XRP and Tron; the Bank of Russia has begun registering crypto exchange operators and custodians, and Sberbank plans its own crypto products the same day.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯最大证券交易所莫斯科交易所 (MOEX) 高管Boris Blokhin确认，计划依据9月1日生效的加密货币市场立法，于12月1日推出加密货币交易服务，目前正与专业交易者进行系统测试。首批上市资产为比特币、以太坊、Solana、XRP和TRON；俄罗斯央行已开始登记加密交易运营商与托管商，Sberbank也计划同日推出加密产品。

title.en: Moscow Exchange Plans December 1 Crypto Trading Launch With BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, TRX
title.zh: 莫斯科交易所计划12月1日上线加密货币交易，首批含BTC、ETH、SOL、XRP、TRX

summary.en: The Solana Foundation announced that Samsung Wallet and Samsung Pay will support cross-border transfers using stablecoins on Solana. U.S. users can send USDC abroad from late October directly inside the wallet, with built-in fiat on- and off-ramps; the launch covers 82 million Galaxy devices, with Coinbase providing custody via Prime Vault. Foundation president Lily Liu called it a step toward stablecoins entering everyday use.
summary.zh: Solana基金会宣布，三星钱包 (Samsung Wallet) 与Samsung Pay将支持Solana链上的稳定币 (stablecoin) 跨境转账。美国用户自10月最后一周起可直接在钱包内用USDC向海外汇款，内置法币出入金通道；首批覆盖8,200万台Galaxy设备，Coinbase将通过Prime Vault提供托管支持。Lily Liu表示这是稳定币走向大众日常使用的关键一步。

title.en: Samsung Partners With Solana to Bring USDC Transfers to 82 Million Galaxy Devices
title.zh: 三星与Solana合作，8,200万台Galaxy设备将支持USDC跨境转账

summary.en: Ethereum Foundation researcher Justin Drake urged the industry to plan for 'bunker mode' after OpenAI released 722 mathematics manuscripts, arguing AI could break the elliptic-curve signatures (ECDSA) securing Bitcoin and Ether wallets 'in months, not years,' and recommending an orderly migration of funds to fresh addresses. Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin responded that the risk is real but holders should not panic.
summary.zh: 以太坊基金会研究员Justin Drake在X上呼吁行业为“掩体模式 (bunker mode)”做准备：在OpenAI近日发布722份数学研究成果之后，他认为人工智能可能在“数月而非数年”内破解保护比特币与以太坊钱包的椭圆曲线签名 (ECDSA)，建议资金有序迁移至公钥从未暴露的新地址。以太坊联合创始人Vitalik Buterin回应称风险真实但无需恐慌。

title.en: Ethereum Researcher Justin Drake Urges 'Bunker Mode' as AI Could Crack Wallet Signatures Before Quantum
title.zh: 以太坊研究员Justin Drake呼吁为“掩体模式”做准备：AI或先于量子计算机破解钱包签名
